examples.en: Her agitation was obvious when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到壞消息時，激動的情緒非常明顯。

examples.en: The manager noticed some agitation among the staff before the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理注意到會議前員工之間有些不安。

examples.en: Public agitation over the price increase grew last week.
examples.zh: 民眾對漲價的不滿情緒上週持續升高。

examples.en: Our school offers a class about AI and robots.
examples.zh: 我們學校開了一門關於人工智慧與機器人的課。

examples.en: The company uses AI to answer simple customer questions.
examples.zh: 這家公司用人工智慧回答簡單的客戶問題。

examples.en: Many people wonder how AI will change office work.
examples.zh: 許多人好奇人工智慧會如何改變辦公室的工作。

examples.en: The mayor's aide handed her a list of today's meetings.
examples.zh: 市長的助理遞給她一份今天的會議清單。

examples.en: A teaching aide helps the students with their reading.
examples.zh: 教學助理協助學生閱讀。

examples.en: He works as an aide to a member of the city council.
examples.zh: 他擔任一位市議員的幕僚。

examples.en: The airlift brought food and water to the isolated village.
examples.zh: 這次空運把食物和水送到了與外界隔絕的村莊。

examples.en: An airlift was the only way to deliver the medicine in time.
examples.zh: 空運是及時送達藥品的唯一方法。

examples.en: The government organized an airlift after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，政府安排了空運救援。

examples.en: The army will airlift supplies to the mountain area.
examples.zh: 軍方將空運物資到山區。

examples.en: They airlifted the injured hiker to a hospital.
examples.zh: 他們把受傷的登山客空運到醫院。

examples.en: Relief teams airlifted blankets to the families in need.
examples.zh: 救援團隊把毛毯空運給有需要的家庭。

examples.en: The number of students who go to bed late is alarming.
examples.zh: 晚睡的學生人數多得令人擔心。

examples.en: Doctors noticed an alarming change in his test results.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到他的檢查結果有令人擔憂的變化。

examples.en: The lake is shrinking at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 這座湖正以驚人的速度縮小。

examples.en: The company denied the allegation of cheating customers.
examples.zh: 公司否認欺騙顧客的指控。

examples.en: The teacher took the allegation seriously and began an inquiry.
examples.zh: 老師認真看待這項指控，並展開調查。

examples.en: There is no evidence to support the allegation.
examples.zh: 沒有證據支持這項指控。

examples.en: The alleged thief was questioned by the police.
examples.zh: 這名竊盜嫌疑人接受了警方詢問。

examples.en: The alleged mistake in the report has been corrected.
examples.zh: 報告中據稱的錯誤已經更正。

examples.en: Officials are looking into the alleged problem at the factory.
examples.zh: 官員正在調查工廠據稱存在的問題。

examples.en: This medicine can alleviate the pain in your knee.
examples.zh: 這種藥可以減輕你膝蓋的疼痛。

examples.en: More buses will alleviate the traffic problem downtown.
examples.zh: 增加公車班次將緩解市中心的塞車問題。

examples.en: A short walk may alleviate your stress.
examples.zh: 散個步或許能緩解你的壓力。

examples.en: The allied countries signed a trade agreement.
examples.zh: 這些同盟國簽署了一份貿易協定。

examples.en: Allied forces worked together to protect the coast.
examples.zh: 聯軍合作保衛海岸。

examples.en: Biology and chemistry are allied fields of study.
examples.zh: 生物學與化學是相關的研究領域。

examples.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.
examples.zh: 青銅是銅和錫的合金。

examples.en: This bike frame is made of a light alloy.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是用輕質合金製成的。

examples.en: The lab is testing a new alloy for airplane parts.
examples.zh: 實驗室正在測試一種用於飛機零件的新合金。

examples.en: Workers alloy the two metals at a high temperature.
examples.zh: 工人在高溫下把這兩種金屬熔成合金。

examples.en: The factory alloys iron with a little carbon.
examples.zh: 工廠把鐵與少量的碳熔成合金。

examples.en: They alloyed silver and copper to make the coins harder.
examples.zh: 他們把銀與銅製成合金，讓硬幣更堅硬。

examples.en: The travelers fell into an ambush on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 旅人在山路上遭到了埋伏。

examples.en: The soldiers set up an ambush near the bridge.
examples.zh: 士兵們在橋邊設下埋伏。

examples.en: The movie begins with an ambush in a dark forest.
examples.zh: 這部電影從黑暗森林裡的一場伏擊開始。

examples.en: The wolves ambush their prey in the tall grass.
examples.zh: 狼群在高高的草叢中伏擊獵物。

examples.en: Reporters tried to ambush the singer outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 記者試圖在旅館外攔堵那位歌手。

examples.en: The knights planned to ambush the enemy at dawn.
examples.zh: 騎士們計畫在黎明時伏擊敵軍。

examples.en: The committee approved an amendment to the school rules.
examples.zh: 委員會通過了校規的一項修正案。

examples.en: She made a small amendment to the contract before signing it.
examples.zh: 她在簽約前對合約做了一處小修改。

examples.en: The amendment will take effect next year.
examples.zh: 這項修正案明年開始生效。

examples.en: He bought her a gift to make amends for being late.
examples.zh: 他買了禮物給她，彌補自己遲到的過錯。

examples.en: The company offered to make amends to the angry customers.
examples.zh: 公司願意對憤怒的顧客做出補償。

examples.en: I want to make amends for my rude words.
examples.zh: 我想為我無禮的言詞賠不是。

examples.en: Our new neighbor is an amiable man who always says hello.
examples.zh: 我們的新鄰居是個和藹可親的人，總是主動打招呼。

examples.en: The amiable guide made the tourists feel welcome.
examples.zh: 親切的導遊讓遊客感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She gave an amiable smile to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她對房間裡的每個人露出友善的微笑。

examples.en: The two companies reached an amicable agreement.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司達成了友好的協議。

examples.en: They had an amicable talk about sharing the cost.
examples.zh: 他們友好地談了費用分攤的問題。

examples.en: The couple stayed on amicable terms after the divorce.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻離婚後仍維持和睦的關係。

examples.en: The museum has a collection of old ammunition.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了一批舊彈藥。

examples.en: The soldiers checked how much ammunition was left.
examples.zh: 士兵們清點還剩下多少彈藥。

examples.en: The guide explained how ammunition was stored in the old fort.
examples.zh: 導覽員解說了舊要塞裡彈藥的存放方式。

examples.en: The government announced an amnesty for the prisoners.
examples.zh: 政府宣布對囚犯實施大赦。

examples.en: The library offered an amnesty for overdue books.
examples.zh: 圖書館對逾期未還的書籍提供免罰期。

examples.en: Several groups asked for an amnesty for the workers.
examples.zh: 幾個團體要求對這些工人特赦。

examples.en: Our teacher began the lesson with a funny anecdote.
examples.zh: 老師用一則有趣的軼事開始上課。

examples.en: He told an anecdote about his first day at work.
examples.zh: 他講了一則關於他第一天上班的趣聞。

examples.en: The book is full of short anecdotes about famous artists.
examples.zh: 這本書裡滿是關於知名藝術家的短篇軼事。

examples.en: The angler waited quietly by the river all morning.
examples.zh: 那位釣客整個早上都安靜地在河邊等待。

examples.en: Many anglers visit this lake in the spring.
examples.zh: 許多釣客在春天來到這座湖。

examples.en: An old angler showed the boy how to tie a hook.
examples.zh: 一位老釣客教那個男孩怎麼綁釣鉤。

examples.en: Antarctic ice is melting faster than before.
examples.zh: 南極的冰比以前融化得更快。

examples.en: Scientists at the Antarctic station study the weather.
examples.zh: 南極站的科學家研究當地的天氣。

examples.en: Many penguins in the Antarctic region depend on the ocean for food.
examples.zh: 許多生活在南極地區的企鵝仰賴海洋取得食物。

examples.en: We moved the antenna to get a clearer picture on the TV.
examples.zh: 我們移動了天線，讓電視畫面更清楚。

examples.en: The car's antenna was damaged in the storm.
examples.zh: 那輛車的天線在暴風雨中損壞了。

examples.en: An ant uses its antenna to feel the world around it.
examples.zh: 螞蟻用觸角感知周遭的環境。

examples.en: The body makes antibodies to fight a virus.
examples.zh: 人體會製造抗體來對抗病毒。

examples.en: A blood test can show whether you have the antibody.
examples.zh: 驗血可以得知你是否有這種抗體。

examples.en: The vaccine helps your body build antibodies.
examples.zh: 疫苗幫助你的身體產生抗體。

examples.en: Apartheid was a system of racial separation in South Africa.
examples.zh: 種族隔離是南非曾經實施的一種種族分離制度。

examples.en: Our history teacher talked about the end of apartheid.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師談到種族隔離政策的終結。

examples.en: Many people around the world spoke out against apartheid.
examples.zh: 世界各地許多人公開反對種族隔離政策。

examples.en: The poor food quality at the cafeteria appalled the parents.
examples.zh: 學生餐廳糟糕的餐點品質讓家長們震驚。

examples.en: The poor conditions at the animal shelter appalled the visiting students.
examples.zh: 動物收容所的惡劣環境讓參觀的學生震驚。

examples.en: The mess in the kitchen appalled his mother.
examples.zh: 廚房的髒亂讓他的媽媽大為震驚。

examples.en: The weather was appalling during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行期間的天氣糟透了。

examples.en: The hotel room was in an appalling condition.
examples.zh: 那間旅館房間的狀況糟糕透頂。

examples.en: She was shocked by the appalling noise from the street.
examples.zh: 她被街上駭人的噪音嚇了一跳。

examples.en: The students set up the apparatus for the science experiment.
examples.zh: 學生們為科學實驗架設了儀器。

examples.en: The gym has a new apparatus for balance training.
examples.zh: 健身房新增了一套平衡訓練的設備。

examples.en: The firefighters tested the breathing apparatus before entering the smoky building.
examples.zh: 消防員進入濃煙瀰漫的建築物前，先測試呼吸裝置。

examples.en: You can find the full list of words in the appendix.
examples.zh: 你可以在附錄中找到完整的單字表。

examples.en: The report has an appendix with extra charts.
examples.zh: 這份報告有一個附錄，裡面有額外的圖表。

examples.en: He had his appendix removed at the hospital last week.
examples.zh: 他上週在醫院割除了闌尾。

examples.en: The teacher gave an honest appraisal of my essay.
examples.zh: 老師對我的作文做了誠實的評價。

examples.en: We asked an expert for an appraisal of the old painting.
examples.zh: 我們請專家鑑定那幅舊畫。

examples.en: Each employee has an annual appraisal with the manager.
examples.zh: 每位員工每年都要和經理進行一次考績面談。

examples.en: There was an appreciable difference between the two phones.
examples.zh: 這兩支手機之間有明顯的差異。

examples.en: The new bus line saved us an appreciable amount of time.
examples.zh: 新的公車路線替我們省下了可觀的時間。

examples.en: Sales showed no appreciable growth last month.
examples.zh: 上個月的銷售額沒有明顯的成長。

examples.en: She felt some apprehension before the job interview.
examples.zh: 她在工作面試前感到有些不安。

examples.en: The students waited with apprehension for their test scores.
examples.zh: 學生們憂心忡忡地等待考試成績。

examples.en: His apprehension grew as the plane began to shake.
examples.zh: 飛機開始搖晃時，他的憂慮越來越深。

examples.en: She has a natural aptitude for languages.
examples.zh: 她對語言有天生的天分。

examples.en: The school gave every student an aptitude test.
examples.zh: 學校讓每位學生做了性向測驗。

examples.en: His aptitude for math helped him win the contest.
examples.zh: 他的數學天賦幫助他贏得了比賽。

examples.en: The teacher said the seating order was not arbitrary.
examples.zh: 老師說座位的順序不是隨意安排的。

examples.en: It was an arbitrary decision with no clear reason.
examples.zh: 那是一個沒有明確理由的武斷決定。

examples.en: The company was criticized for its arbitrary rules.
examples.zh: 這家公司因為其任意訂定的規則而受到批評。

examples.en: The ball moved in a high arc over the net.
examples.zh: 球以一道高高的弧線越過球網。

examples.en: A rainbow formed a bright arc across the sky.
examples.zh: 彩虹在天空中劃出一道明亮的弧形。

examples.en: Draw an arc with the compass on the paper.
examples.zh: 用圓規在紙上畫一道弧線。

examples.en: The old station is an architectural treasure.
examples.zh: 這座老車站是一件建築瑰寶。

examples.en: She studied architectural design at university before joining a local firm.
examples.zh: 她在大學主修建築設計，之後加入了一家當地公司。

examples.en: Tourists admire the architectural beauty of the temple.
examples.zh: 遊客們欣賞這座寺廟的建築之美。

examples.en: Arctic winds made the town extremely cold.
examples.zh: 極寒的風讓這座小鎮冷得不得了。

examples.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
examples.zh: 北極熊生活在北極地區。

examples.en: Scientists measure the Arctic ice every summer.
examples.zh: 科學家每年夏天都會測量北極的冰層。

examples.en: Few people live in the Arctic because of its extreme climate.
examples.zh: 由於氣候極端，北極地區的居民很少。

examples.en: The Arctic is getting warmer every year.
examples.zh: 北極地區一年比一年暖和。

examples.en: The documentary was filmed in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片是在北極地區拍攝的。

examples.en: The museum displays a knight's armor from the 1400s.
examples.zh: 博物館展出一套十五世紀騎士的盔甲。

examples.en: The truck is covered with heavy armor.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車覆蓋著厚重的裝甲。

examples.en: Some animals have natural armor to protect their bodies.
examples.zh: 有些動物擁有天然的盔甲來保護身體。

examples.en: Blood flows from the heart through the arteries.
examples.zh: 血液從心臟經過動脈流出。

examples.en: The doctor said one of his arteries was partly blocked.
examples.zh: 醫生說他有一條動脈部分阻塞。

examples.en: This road is the main artery of the city.
examples.zh: 這條路是這座城市的主要幹道。

examples.en: The museum keeps an ancient artifact in a glass case.
examples.zh: 博物館把一件古代文物放在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: Students dug up several artifacts at the old site.
examples.zh: 學生們在古蹟遺址挖出了幾件文物。

examples.en: This artifact is more than two thousand years old.
examples.zh: 這件文物已有兩千多年的歷史。

examples.en: The old fort displays artillery from the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這座舊要塞展示著十九世紀的大砲。

examples.en: The artillery was moved to a safer position.
examples.zh: 砲兵部隊被移到較安全的位置。

examples.en: Our history book has a chapter about artillery.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史課本有一章在談砲兵。

examples.en: The police tried to ascertain the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方試圖查明火災的原因。

examples.en: Please ascertain the exact time of the meeting.
examples.zh: 請確認會議的準確時間。

examples.en: We called the hotel to ascertain whether rooms were available.
examples.zh: 我們打電話給旅館，確認是否還有空房。

examples.en: Many people ascribe his success to hard work.
examples.zh: 許多人把他的成功歸功於努力。

examples.en: The teacher ascribed the low scores to the difficult test.
examples.zh: 老師把低分歸因於考題太難。

examples.en: This poem is usually ascribed to a famous writer.
examples.zh: 這首詩通常被認為是一位著名作家的作品。

examples.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的志向是成為醫生。

examples.en: Students shared their aspirations for the future in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上分享了對未來的抱負。

examples.en: He has high aspirations for his small business.
examples.zh: 他對自己的小生意抱有很高的期望。

examples.en: The teacher gave us an assessment at the end of the unit.
examples.zh: 老師在單元結束時給了我們一次評量。

examples.en: The manager made an honest assessment of the project.
examples.zh: 經理對這個專案做了誠實的評估。

examples.en: A doctor's assessment is needed before you join the team.
examples.zh: 加入球隊前需要先經過醫生的評估。

examples.en: Our English teacher gave us a long assignment.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師出了一份很長的作業。

examples.en: The reporter received a new assignment in Japan.
examples.zh: 那位記者接到了一項前往日本的新任務。

examples.en: The assignment of roles helped every student understand the group project.
examples.zh: 分派角色讓每位學生更了解這項小組專題。

examples.en: Young children assimilate new words very quickly.
examples.zh: 幼兒吸收新單字的速度非常快。

examples.en: It took the family a year to assimilate into the new town.
examples.zh: 這家人花了一年才融入新的小鎮。

examples.en: The body needs time to assimilate the nutrients in food.
examples.zh: 身體需要時間吸收食物中的養分。

senses.zh: 有把握的；確定的；自信的

examples.en: With the scholarship, her place at college is assured.
examples.zh: 有了獎學金，她的大學名額就確定了。

examples.en: He gave an assured answer to every question.
examples.zh: 他對每個問題都回答得很有自信。

examples.en: You can be assured that we will fix the problem.
examples.zh: 你可以放心，我們會解決這個問題。

examples.en: The family asked for asylum in a safe country.
examples.zh: 這家人向一個安全的國家申請庇護。

examples.en: The government granted asylum to the writer.
examples.zh: 政府給予那位作家庇護。

examples.en: Thousands of people sought asylum last year.
examples.zh: 去年有數千人尋求庇護。

examples.en: I stopped at the ATM to take out some cash.
examples.zh: 我在自動櫃員機停下來提了些現金。

examples.en: The ATM near the station is out of order again.
examples.zh: 車站附近的自動櫃員機又故障了。

examples.en: You can check your balance at the ATM inside the bank.
examples.zh: 你可以在銀行內的自動櫃員機查詢餘額。

examples.en: The history lesson was about an atrocity during the war.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課談的是戰爭期間的一項暴行。

examples.en: Leaders around the world condemned the atrocity.
examples.zh: 世界各國領袖譴責這項暴行。

examples.en: The museum helps people remember the atrocities of the past.
examples.zh: 這間博物館幫助人們記住過去的暴行。

examples.en: Please read the attached file before the meeting.
examples.zh: 請在會議前閱讀附上的檔案。

examples.en: The boy is very attached to his grandmother.
examples.zh: 這個男孩非常依戀他的奶奶。

examples.en: The school has a small garden attached to it.
examples.zh: 這所學校附設了一座小花園。

examples.en: The police reported an attempted theft at the store last night.
examples.zh: 警方通報昨晚這家店發生竊盜未遂。

examples.en: The attempted repair did not fix the broken printer.
examples.zh: 這次嘗試修理並沒有修好壞掉的印表機。

examples.en: He apologized for his attempted joke at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他為自己在會議上沒開好的玩笑道歉。

examples.en: She attempted to open the window, but it was stuck.
examples.zh: 她試著打開窗戶，但窗戶卡住了。

examples.en: The team attempted a new method in the experiment.
examples.zh: 這個團隊在實驗中嘗試了一種新方法。

examples.en: Tom has attempted the exam twice already.
examples.zh: 湯姆已經應考過兩次了。

examples.en: This book is an authoritative guide to English grammar.
examples.zh: 這本書是英文文法的權威指南。

examples.en: She spoke in an authoritative voice, and everyone listened.
examples.zh: 她用威嚴的語氣說話，大家都專心聆聽。

examples.en: We need an authoritative source for this information.
examples.zh: 我們需要這項資訊的可靠來源。

examples.en: The auto show opens in Taipei next month.
examples.zh: 汽車展下個月在台北開幕。

examples.en: My uncle works in the auto industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在汽車業工作。

examples.en: The company sells auto parts online to customers across the country.
examples.zh: 這家公司在網路上向全國各地的顧客販售汽車零件。

examples.en: Automation has changed the way factories work.
examples.zh: 自動化改變了工廠的運作方式。

examples.en: The company invested in office automation to save time.
examples.zh: 這家公司投資辦公室自動化來節省時間。

examples.en: Some workers worry that automation will take their jobs.
examples.zh: 有些員工擔心自動化會取代他們的工作。

senses.zh: 自主的；自治的；自動駕駛的

examples.en: The region became an autonomous area ten years ago.
examples.zh: 這個地區十年前成為自治區。

examples.en: Autonomous cars use cameras to read the road.
examples.zh: 自動駕駛汽車使用攝影機判讀路況。

examples.en: Students should become autonomous learners as they grow up.
examples.zh: 學生長大後應該成為自主學習者。

examples.en: We called for help, but it was of no avail.
examples.zh: 我們打電話求助，但一點用處也沒有。

examples.en: His apology was of little avail after he had missed the deadline.
examples.zh: 他錯過截止期限後，道歉也沒什麼用處。

examples.en: All our efforts were to no avail.
examples.zh: 我們所有的努力都徒勞無功。

examples.en: You should avail yourself of the free library service.
examples.zh: 你應該利用免費的圖書館服務。

examples.en: Students can avail themselves of extra classes after school.
examples.zh: 學生可以利用放學後的加強課程。

examples.en: Customers may avail themselves of the discount until Friday.
examples.zh: 顧客可享有這項折扣，優惠至週五為止。

examples.en: We watched colorful parrots in the aviary at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園的鳥舍裡觀賞色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡。

examples.en: The park built a new aviary for rare birds.
examples.zh: 這座公園為稀有鳥類蓋了一座新鳥舍。

examples.en: Children love walking through the aviary on weekends.
examples.zh: 孩子們週末喜歡走進鳥類館參觀。

examples.en: The Earth turns on its axis once a day.
examples.zh: 地球每天繞著地軸自轉一圈。

examples.en: Draw the horizontal axis first, then the vertical axis.
examples.zh: 先畫橫軸，再畫縱軸。

examples.en: The two countries formed an axis of cooperation in trade.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家在貿易上形成合作軸心。

examples.en: The plan needs the backing of the school board.
examples.zh: 這項計畫需要校務委員會的支持。

examples.en: The new club received financial backing from local shops.
examples.zh: 新社團獲得當地商家的資金支持。

examples.en: The poster has a thick cardboard backing.
examples.zh: 這張海報有一層厚紙板襯底。

examples.en: The math problem baffled the whole class.
examples.zh: 這道數學題難倒了全班。

examples.en: His strange answer baffled the teacher during the science lesson.
examples.zh: 他在自然課上的奇怪答案讓老師困惑。

examples.en: The missing keys baffled everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 不見的鑰匙讓辦公室裡的每個人都百思不解。

examples.en: The man was released on bail the next morning.
examples.zh: 那名男子隔天早上獲得保釋。

examples.en: His family paid the bail so he could go home.
examples.zh: 他的家人繳了保釋金，讓他能回家。

examples.en: The judge set bail at five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 法官將保釋金定為五千元。

examples.en: We had to bail water out of the small boat.
examples.zh: 我們得把小船裡的水舀出去。

examples.en: His family bailed him out after the judge set the amount.
examples.zh: 法官訂定保釋金額後，他的家人替他交保。

examples.en: Two members bailed on the project at the last minute.
examples.zh: 有兩名成員在最後一刻退出了這個專案。

examples.en: The old story is about a bandit who lived in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事講的是住在山裡的一名土匪。

examples.en: Travelers were afraid of bandits on the lonely road.
examples.zh: 旅人們害怕這條偏僻道路上的強盜。

examples.en: The movie tells how a bandit became a hero.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一名強盜如何成為英雄。

examples.en: The store filed for bankruptcy after losing many customers.
examples.zh: 這家店流失許多客人後申請破產。

examples.en: Bankruptcy can happen when a company owes too much money.
examples.zh: 公司欠債太多時就可能破產。

examples.en: He recovered from bankruptcy and opened a new shop.
examples.zh: 他從破產中重新站起來，開了一家新店。

examples.en: The barefoot children ran across the warm sand.
examples.zh: 赤腳的孩子們跑過溫暖的沙灘。

examples.en: A barefoot girl stood at the edge of the pool.
examples.zh: 一個赤腳的女孩站在泳池邊。

examples.en: It is not safe to be barefoot in the workshop.
examples.zh: 在工坊裡赤腳是不安全的。

examples.en: The boys played soccer barefoot on the grass.
examples.zh: 男孩們赤腳在草地上踢足球。

examples.en: She likes to walk barefoot on the beach.
examples.zh: 她喜歡赤腳走在海灘上。

examples.en: Please do not go barefoot in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 請不要在廚房裡赤腳走動。

examples.en: A long barge carried sand down the river.
examples.zh: 一艘長長的駁船沿著河川運送沙子。

examples.en: The barge moved slowly under the bridge.
examples.zh: 那艘駁船緩緩地從橋下駛過。

examples.en: Tourists took a barge ride along the canal.
examples.zh: 遊客搭乘平底船遊覽運河。

examples.en: Please don't barge into the room without knocking.
examples.zh: 請不要不敲門就闖進房間。

examples.en: A man barged past me and ran for the train.
examples.zh: 有個人從我身旁擠過去，衝向火車。

examples.en: She barged into the meeting and interrupted the manager.
examples.zh: 她闖進會議室，打斷了經理的話。

examples.en: The barometer shows that a storm is coming.
examples.zh: 氣壓計顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

examples.en: My grandfather keeps an old barometer in the hall.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在走廊裡放了一個舊氣壓計。

examples.en: Sales are a good barometer of how the shop is doing.
examples.zh: 銷售額是衡量這家店經營狀況的良好指標。

examples.en: Some fans barracked the visiting team loudly.
examples.zh: 一些球迷對客隊大聲喝倒彩。

examples.en: It is rude to barrack a speaker during a talk.
examples.zh: 在演講中對講者起鬨是很沒禮貌的。

examples.en: The crowd barracked the referee after the call.
examples.zh: 那個判決之後，群眾對裁判發出噓聲。

examples.en: The soldiers returned to the barracks after the drill.
examples.zh: 士兵們演習結束後回到營房。

examples.en: The old barracks have been turned into a museum.
examples.zh: 這棟舊營房已被改建成博物館。

examples.en: Each barracks holds about forty people during the training program.
examples.zh: 訓練期間，每間營房大約可容納四十人。

examples.en: Workers put up a barricade around the broken road.
examples.zh: 工人在損壞的路面周圍設置了路障。

examples.en: The police set a barricade at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 警方在街尾設置了路障。

examples.en: Boxes formed a barricade across the doorway.
examples.zh: 箱子在門口堆成了一道屏障。

examples.en: They barricaded the door with a heavy table.
examples.zh: 他們用一張沉重的桌子把門堵住。

examples.en: The shop owner barricaded the windows before the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風來臨前，店主把窗戶封住。

examples.en: Fallen trees barricaded the mountain road after the severe storm.
examples.zh: 猛烈風暴過後，倒下的樹木堵住了山路。

examples.en: He bashed his knee against the table.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋猛地撞上桌子。

examples.en: Critics bashed the new movie for its weak story.
examples.zh: 評論家痛批這部新電影的劇情薄弱。

examples.en: Be careful not to bash the door when you carry the boxes.
examples.zh: 搬箱子時小心別撞到門。

examples.en: Our school is planning a big bash for the graduates.
examples.zh: 我們學校正計畫為畢業生辦一場盛大的派對。

examples.en: She gave the ball a hard bash with the bat.
examples.zh: 她用球棒猛力擊打那顆球。

examples.en: Everyone came to the birthday bash on Saturday.
examples.zh: 每個人都來參加了週六的生日派對。

examples.en: Basically, the two plans are the same.
examples.zh: 基本上，這兩個計畫是一樣的。

examples.en: The report is basically finished, but it needs a title.
examples.zh: 這份報告基本上完成了，只差一個標題。

examples.en: He is basically a shy person who loves reading.
examples.zh: 他基本上是個愛看書的害羞的人。

senses.zh: 混蛋（粗俗用語）；非婚生子女（舊稱）

examples.en: The dictionary labels bastard as an offensive word for an unpleasant person.
examples.zh: 字典將 bastard 列為冒犯性的罵人用語，用來指討厭的人。

examples.en: In the old novel, the child called a bastard could not inherit land.
examples.zh: 在那部舊小說中，被稱為 bastard 的孩子不能繼承土地。

examples.en: The historical biography describes the duke as a bastard born outside marriage.
examples.zh: 這本歷史傳記稱那位公爵為 bastard，指他是非婚生子女。

examples.en: The battalion marched to the camp before sunrise.
examples.zh: 那個營在日出前行軍到營地。

examples.en: A battalion usually has several hundred soldiers.
examples.zh: 一個營通常有幾百名士兵。

examples.en: A battalion of volunteers cleaned the beach.
examples.zh: 一大群志工把海灘清理乾淨。

examples.en: Tourists visit the old battlefield every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有遊客參觀這個古戰場。

examples.en: The museum has maps of the famous battlefield.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有這處著名戰場的地圖。

examples.en: The meeting room became a battlefield of opinions.
examples.zh: 會議室成了意見交鋒的戰場。

examples.en: We bought spices at the bazaar in Istanbul.
examples.zh: 我們在伊斯坦堡的市集買了香料。

examples.en: The school held a charity bazaar in December.
examples.zh: 學校在十二月舉辦了慈善義賣會。

examples.en: The old bazaar is full of colorful scarves and lamps.
examples.zh: 這座老市集裡滿是色彩繽紛的圍巾和燈飾。

examples.en: Your question has no bearing on today's topic.
examples.zh: 你的問題與今天的主題無關。

examples.en: The sailor checked his bearing with a compass.
examples.zh: 水手用羅盤確認他的方位。

examples.en: She has a calm bearing in front of a crowd.
examples.zh: 她在群眾面前舉止沉穩。

examples.en: The teacher beckoned the student to come closer.
examples.zh: 老師招手要學生靠近一點。

examples.en: The warm beach beckoned us to stay another day.
examples.zh: 溫暖的海灘吸引我們多待一天。

examples.en: A waiter beckoned to us from across the room.
examples.zh: 服務生從房間另一頭向我們招手。

examples.en: The bent nail would not go into the wall.
examples.zh: 那根彎曲的釘子釘不進牆裡。

examples.en: He picked up a bent spoon from the floor.
examples.zh: 他從地上撿起一支彎掉的湯匙。

examples.en: The old man walked with a bent back.
examples.zh: 老先生駝著背走路。

examples.en: She has a natural bent for music.
examples.zh: 她天生有音樂天分。

examples.en: His bent for art showed when he was little.
examples.zh: 他的藝術天分從小就顯現出來。

examples.en: Students follow their own bent when they choose a club.
examples.zh: 學生選擇社團時會依照自己的傾向。

examples.en: He bent down to tie his shoes.
examples.zh: 他彎下身繫鞋帶。

examples.en: The strong wind bent the small tree.
examples.zh: 強風把那棵小樹吹彎了。

examples.en: She bent the wire into the shape of a heart.
examples.zh: 她把鐵絲彎成愛心的形狀。

examples.en: The army besieged the city for three months.
examples.zh: 軍隊圍攻這座城市長達三個月。

examples.en: Reporters besieged the singer outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 記者在飯店外團團圍住那位歌手。

examples.en: Fans besieged the ticket office on the first day.
examples.zh: 首日歌迷擠爆了售票處。

examples.en: The long list of rules bewildered the new students.
examples.zh: 一長串的規定讓新生不知所措。

examples.en: The strange map bewildered the tourists as they searched for the station.
examples.zh: 遊客尋找車站時，那張奇怪的地圖讓他們一頭霧水。

examples.en: His sudden question bewildered me during the job interview.
examples.zh: 面試時，他突如其來的問題讓我感到困惑。

examples.en: Please add a bibliography at the end of your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告最後附上參考書目。

examples.en: The teacher checked the bibliography for mistakes.
examples.zh: 老師檢查了參考書目有沒有錯誤。

examples.en: This book has a long bibliography on climate change.
examples.zh: 這本書附有一份很長的氣候變遷參考書目。

examples.en: The book has a beautiful leather binding.
examples.zh: 這本書有漂亮的皮革裝訂。

examples.en: The binding came loose after years of use.
examples.zh: 使用多年後，裝訂鬆脫了。

examples.en: We chose a spiral binding for the report.
examples.zh: 我們為報告選了螺旋裝訂。

senses.zh: 有約束力的；具法律效力的

examples.en: The contract is legally binding for both sides.
examples.zh: 這份合約對雙方都具有法律約束力。

examples.en: The judge's decision is binding on both parties in the dispute.
examples.zh: 法官的裁決對爭議雙方都有約束力。

examples.en: Our agreement is binding once we sign it.
examples.zh: 我們一簽字，協議就有約束力。

examples.en: He watched the birds through his binoculars.
examples.zh: 他用雙筒望遠鏡觀察鳥類。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my binoculars to the concert.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶雙筒望遠鏡去演唱會。

examples.en: A pair of binoculars hung from her neck.
examples.zh: 她的脖子上掛著一副雙筒望遠鏡。

examples.en: She studies biochemistry at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學修讀生物化學。

examples.en: Biochemistry explains how our bodies use food.
examples.zh: 生物化學解釋了我們的身體如何利用食物。

examples.en: The biochemistry lab opens at nine every morning.
examples.zh: 生物化學實驗室每天早上九點開門。

senses.zh: 小鳥；羽毛球；低於標準桿一桿的成績

examples.en: Look at the little birdie on the branch.
examples.zh: 看看樹枝上那隻小鳥。

examples.en: He hit the birdie over the net with a quick swing.
examples.zh: 他快速揮拍，把羽毛球打過網。

examples.en: She scored a birdie on the last hole.
examples.zh: 她在最後一洞打出了低於標準桿一桿的小鳥球。

examples.en: The bitch guarded her puppies near the barn.
examples.zh: 那隻母狗在穀倉旁守護著牠的小狗。

examples.en: A vet checked the bitch before she gave birth.
examples.zh: 獸醫在那隻母狗生產前替牠做了檢查。

examples.en: The dictionary marks bitch as offensive when used to insult a person.
examples.zh: 字典指出，用 bitch 來辱罵他人具有冒犯性。

examples.en: The blacksmith made a new gate for the farm.
examples.zh: 鐵匠為農場打造了一扇新門。

examples.en: Visitors watched the blacksmith shape hot iron.
examples.zh: 遊客看著鐵匠鍛造燒紅的鐵塊。

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a blacksmith in a small village.
examples.zh: 他的祖父在一個小村莊當鐵匠。

examples.en: The soup was too bland, so I added some salt.
examples.zh: 這碗湯太淡了，所以我加了一些鹽。

examples.en: The hotel room had bland white walls.
examples.zh: 這間飯店房間的牆壁是單調的白色。

examples.en: His bland speech made the audience sleepy.
examples.zh: 他乏味的演說讓聽眾昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: Car horns blared in the busy street.
examples.zh: 繁忙的街上汽車喇叭聲大作。

examples.en: Loud music blared from the next room.
examples.zh: 隔壁房間傳來震耳的音樂聲。

examples.en: The alarm blared at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 鬧鐘在早上六點刺耳地響起。

examples.en: The blare of the horn woke the baby.
examples.zh: 喇叭的刺耳聲吵醒了寶寶。

examples.en: We could hear the blare of the radio from outside.
examples.zh: 我們在外面就能聽到收音機的巨響。

examples.en: The blare of the siren filled the street.
examples.zh: 警笛的尖響充滿整條街。

examples.en: The bleak hills looked empty in the winter wind.
examples.zh: 冬風中，荒涼的山丘顯得空蕩蕩。

examples.en: The future looked bleak after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，前景顯得黯淡。

examples.en: It was a bleak and rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 那是一個陰冷多雨的下午。

examples.en: A blizzard closed the roads for two days.
examples.zh: 一場暴風雪讓道路封閉了兩天。

examples.en: The hikers were caught in a blizzard on the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客在山上遇到暴風雪。

examples.en: School was cancelled because of the blizzard.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雪，學校停課了。

examples.en: The countries formed a trade bloc in the region.
examples.zh: 這些國家在區域內組成了貿易集團。

examples.en: Several nations in the bloc agreed on the new rule.
examples.zh: 集團中的幾個國家同意了這項新規定。

examples.en: The voting bloc supported the new law.
examples.zh: 這個投票集團支持這項新法案。

examples.en: The port was under a blockade for months.
examples.zh: 這座港口被封鎖了好幾個月。

examples.en: The blockade made it hard to bring in food.
examples.zh: 封鎖使得食物很難運進來。

examples.en: A truck broke the blockade at the border.
examples.zh: 一輛卡車突破了邊境的封鎖線。

examples.en: Protesters blockaded the main road during a peaceful demonstration.
examples.zh: 抗議者在一場和平示威中封鎖了主要道路。

examples.en: Local officials blockaded the mountain pass after the avalanche.
examples.zh: 雪崩發生後，地方官員封鎖了山口。

examples.en: Ships blockaded the harbor during the war.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，船艦封鎖了港口。

examples.en: My dad loves to listen to blues on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在週日下午聽藍調音樂。

examples.en: She played the blues on her guitar.
examples.zh: 她用吉他彈奏藍調。

examples.en: Rainy weather gives me the blues when I cannot go outside.
examples.zh: 下雨天無法出門時，我會覺得心情鬱悶。

examples.en: Sending the email to the wrong person was a big blunder.
examples.zh: 把電子郵件寄給錯的人是個大失誤。

examples.en: The team's blunder cost them the game.
examples.zh: 球隊的失誤讓他們輸掉了比賽。

examples.en: He made a blunder when he added up the bill.
examples.zh: 他算帳時犯了一個大錯。

examples.en: The new clerk blundered by giving the wrong change.
examples.zh: 新來的店員找錯錢，出了差錯。

examples.en: He blundered through the dark room looking for the light.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗的房間裡跌跌撞撞地找電燈。

examples.en: The company blundered when it released the product too early.
examples.zh: 公司太早推出產品，犯了大錯。

examples.en: Small boats bobbed up and down on the water.
examples.zh: 小船在水面上上下漂動。

examples.en: She bobbed her head to the music.
examples.zh: 她隨著音樂點頭擺動。

examples.en: A red ball bobbed in the pool.
examples.zh: 一顆紅球在泳池裡浮沉。

examples.en: She cut her hair into a short bob.
examples.zh: 她把頭髮剪成了鮑伯短髮。

examples.en: With a quick bob of his head, he said hello.
examples.zh: 他快速點了一下頭，打了招呼。

examples.en: The girl with the bob smiled at me.
examples.zh: 那個留鮑伯頭的女孩對我微笑。

examples.en: Rare plants grow in the bog near the lake.
examples.zh: 稀有植物生長在湖邊的沼澤裡。

examples.en: We walked carefully across the wet bog.
examples.zh: 我們小心翼翼地走過潮濕的沼澤。

examples.en: The farmer's boots sank into the bog.
examples.zh: 農夫的靴子陷進了泥沼裡。

examples.en: Our car got bogged down in the mud.
examples.zh: 我們的車陷在泥巴裡動彈不得。

examples.en: Don't let small details bog you down.
examples.zh: 別讓小細節拖住你。

examples.en: The project was bogged down by too many meetings.
examples.zh: 這個專案被太多會議拖慢了進度。

examples.en: Pour boiling water over the tea bag.
examples.zh: 把沸水倒在茶包上。

examples.en: It was boiling hot in the classroom.
examples.zh: 那間教室熱得要命。

examples.en: Be careful with the boiling soup on the stove.
examples.zh: 小心爐子上滾燙的湯。

examples.en: The coach tried to bolster the team's confidence.
examples.zh: 教練試著增強球隊的信心。

examples.en: New programs will bolster the local economy.
examples.zh: 新的方案將提振地方經濟。

examples.en: Good grades bolster a student's chances of getting in.
examples.zh: 好成績能提高學生錄取的機會。

examples.en: She put a bolster behind her back on the sofa.
examples.zh: 她在沙發上把長枕放在背後。

examples.en: The bed had a soft bolster at the top.
examples.zh: 這張床頭有個柔軟的長枕。

examples.en: A wooden bolster supports the bridge beam.
examples.zh: 一根木製支撐物撐住橋樑的橫梁。

examples.en: Reporters bombarded the mayor with questions during the press conference.
examples.zh: 記者在記者會上用一連串問題轟炸市長。

examples.en: Advertisements bombard us every time we go online.
examples.zh: 我們每次上網都會被廣告轟炸。

examples.en: Scientists bombard atoms with tiny particles in the lab.
examples.zh: 科學家在實驗室裡用微小粒子撞擊原子。

examples.en: The museum has a restored bomber from the Second World War.
examples.zh: 博物館有一架修復好的二戰轟炸機。

examples.en: Police arrested the bomber before he could reach the station.
examples.zh: 警方在投彈者抵達車站前就逮捕了他。

examples.en: A bomber flew low over the airfield during the air show.
examples.zh: 航空展期間，一架轟炸機低空飛越機場。

examples.en: The novel describes a family's escape from bondage.
examples.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭逃離奴役的經過。

examples.en: Many people were kept in bondage for years in the past.
examples.zh: 過去有許多人多年來一直受到奴役。

examples.en: Freedom from bondage was the main goal of the movement.
examples.zh: 擺脫奴役是那場運動的主要目標。

examples.en: Our school is in the borough of Camden in London.
examples.zh: 我們學校位在倫敦的卡姆登區。

examples.en: The borough council plans to build a new library.
examples.zh: 區議會計畫興建一座新圖書館。

examples.en: She was born in a small borough near the river.
examples.zh: 她出生在河邊的一個小市鎮。

examples.en: Borrowing money from friends can sometimes cause problems.
examples.zh: 向朋友借錢有時會造成問題。

examples.en: The library limits book borrowing to three weeks.
examples.zh: 圖書館把借書期限限制在三週內。

examples.en: Rising prices have led to more borrowing by families.
examples.zh: 物價上漲使家庭的借貸增加。

examples.en: We spent the afternoon at the botanical garden.
examples.zh: 我們在植物園度過了整個下午。

examples.en: She bought a botanical guide to wild flowers.
examples.zh: 她買了一本野花的植物圖鑑。

examples.en: The museum has a large botanical collection from Asia.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有大量來自亞洲的植物標本。

examples.en: She studies botany at the university to learn about local plants.
examples.zh: 她在大學學習植物學，以了解當地的植物。

examples.en: Our botany teacher took us on a field trip.
examples.zh: 我們的植物學老師帶我們去校外教學。

examples.en: Botany helps us understand how plants grow.
examples.zh: 植物學幫助我們了解植物如何生長。

examples.en: He stayed home after a bout of the flu.
examples.zh: 他得了一場流感後就待在家裡。

examples.en: The boxing bout lasted for twelve rounds.
examples.zh: 那場拳擊賽打了十二回合。

examples.en: She had a bout of sleeplessness before the exam.
examples.zh: 她在考試前有一陣子失眠。

examples.en: The doctor checked his bowel for signs of infection.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查他的腸道有沒有感染跡象。

examples.en: Eating fiber helps keep your bowel healthy.
examples.zh: 攝取纖維有助於維持腸道健康。

examples.en: She was sent to the hospital with a bowel problem.
examples.zh: 她因腸道問題被送進醫院。

senses.zh: 投球手（板球）；保齡球選手

examples.en: The bowler took three wickets in the first match.
examples.zh: 那位板球投球手在第一場比賽中讓三名擊球手出局。

examples.en: My uncle is a skilled bowler in our local league.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是我們當地聯盟中技術高超的保齡球手。

examples.en: The new bowler joined the team last week.
examples.zh: 新來的投球手上週加入了球隊。

examples.en: He spent his boyhood in a small fishing village.
examples.zh: 他的少年時代是在一個小漁村度過的。

examples.en: They talked about their boyhood over dinner.
examples.zh: 他們在晚餐時聊起了童年往事。

examples.en: His boyhood dream was to become a pilot.
examples.zh: 他兒時的夢想是成為飛行員。

examples.en: Please write the answer inside the brackets.
examples.zh: 請把答案寫在括號裡面。

examples.en: The shelf is held up by two metal brackets.
examples.zh: 這個架子由兩個金屬支架撐住。

examples.en: Families in this income bracket pay lower taxes.
examples.zh: 屬於這個收入級距的家庭繳的稅比較少。

senses.zh: 把……放入括號；把……歸為一類

examples.en: Please bracket the extra words in the sentence.
examples.zh: 請把句子裡多餘的字放進括號裡。

examples.en: Critics often bracket the two writers together.
examples.zh: 評論家常把這兩位作家歸為同一類。

examples.en: The editor asked me to bracket any unclear numbers.
examples.zh: 編輯要我把任何不清楚的數字放進括號。

examples.en: She wore her hair in a long braid.
examples.zh: 她把頭髮綁成一條長辮子。

examples.en: The little girl's braid came loose during the race.
examples.zh: 小女孩的辮子在賽跑時鬆開了。

examples.en: A gold braid decorated the edge of the uniform.
examples.zh: 制服的邊緣用金色編織帶裝飾。

examples.en: My mother taught me how to braid hair.
examples.zh: 我媽媽教我怎麼編辮子。

examples.en: They braid colorful threads to make bracelets.
examples.zh: 他們把彩色的線編在一起做成手環。

examples.en: She likes to braid flowers into a crown.
examples.zh: 她喜歡把花編成花冠。

examples.en: The company was fined for a breach of safety rules.
examples.zh: 那家公司因違反安全規定而被罰款。

examples.en: Workers repaired the breach in the wall quickly.
examples.zh: 工人很快修好了牆上的缺口。

examples.en: A breach of trust can end a friendship.
examples.zh: 背信可能會結束一段友誼。

examples.en: Any worker who breaches the contract may lose the job.
examples.zh: 任何違反合約的員工都可能丟掉工作。

examples.en: Floodwater breached the bank of the river overnight.
examples.zh: 洪水在一夜之間沖破了河堤。

examples.en: Hackers breached the company's network last month.
examples.zh: 駭客上個月入侵了這間公司的網路。

examples.en: The police are investigating a break-in at the shop.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查那家店遭人闖入的案件。

examples.en: There was a break-in at our school last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們學校上週末有人闖入。

examples.en: After the break-in, they installed a new lock.
examples.zh: 遭人闖入後，他們裝了新的門鎖。

examples.en: The dog breeder showed us the new puppies.
examples.zh: 那位犬隻繁殖業者讓我們看了剛出生的小狗。

examples.en: My uncle is a horse breeder in the countryside.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是鄉下的養馬人。

examples.en: A good breeder cares about the health of the animals.
examples.zh: 好的飼育者會關心動物的健康。

examples.en: My father likes to brew his own beer at home.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在家自己釀啤酒。

examples.en: Let the tea brew for three minutes.
examples.zh: 讓茶泡三分鐘。

examples.en: A storm is brewing over the mountains.
examples.zh: 山區上空正在醞釀一場暴風雨。

senses.zh: 釀造的飲料；沖泡的飲品

examples.en: The café sells a strong brew of black tea.
examples.zh: 那間咖啡店賣一種濃烈的紅茶。

examples.en: He poured a cup of hot brew for his guest.
examples.zh: 他倒了一杯熱飲給客人。

examples.en: This local brew is popular with tourists.
examples.zh: 這種當地釀造的飲品很受觀光客歡迎。

senses.zh: 簡報；簡短說明會；情況介紹

examples.en: The manager held a briefing before the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會議前舉行了簡短說明會。

examples.en: We received a safety briefing at the start of the trip.
examples.zh: 旅程一開始，我們聽了安全說明。

examples.en: The teacher gave a briefing about the school project.
examples.zh: 老師說明了這項學校專題的內容。

examples.en: A fire brigade arrived at the building within minutes.
examples.zh: 消防隊幾分鐘內就抵達了那棟大樓。

examples.en: The army sent a brigade to help after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，陸軍派出一個旅前來協助。

examples.en: A brigade of volunteers cleaned the beach.
examples.zh: 一隊志工清理了海灘。

examples.en: We took a brisk walk around the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園裡快步走了一圈。

examples.en: The shop did brisk business during the holiday.
examples.zh: 這家店在假期期間生意興隆。

examples.en: A brisk wind blew across the lake this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上一陣清冷的風吹過湖面。

examples.en: The old paper was dry and brittle.
examples.zh: 那張舊紙又乾又脆。

examples.en: Cold weather can make plastic brittle and more likely to crack.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣會讓塑膠變脆，更容易裂開。

examples.en: Her voice sounded brittle after the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她的聲音聽起來很脆弱。

examples.en: The broadcaster read the evening news calmly.
examples.zh: 那位播報員平靜地唸著晚間新聞。

examples.en: Our national broadcaster will show the game tonight.
examples.zh: 我們的國家廣播公司今晚將轉播這場比賽。

examples.en: She became a radio broadcaster after college.
examples.zh: 她大學畢業後成為廣播節目主持人。

examples.en: Our broker found us a small apartment near the station.
examples.zh: 我們的仲介幫我們在車站附近找到一間小公寓。

examples.en: The stock broker called his client in the morning.
examples.zh: 證券經紀人早上打電話給他的客戶。

examples.en: An insurance broker explained the different plans to us.
examples.zh: 保險經紀人向我們說明了不同的方案。

examples.en: The mayor helped broker a deal between the two groups.
examples.zh: 市長協助居中促成了兩個團體之間的協議。

examples.en: Leaders tried to broker a peace agreement.
examples.zh: 領導人試圖居中促成和平協議。

examples.en: She brokered a deal to share the office space.
examples.zh: 她居中談成了共用辦公空間的協議。

examples.en: She pinned a silver brooch to her coat.
examples.zh: 她把一枚銀色胸針別在外套上。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me her old brooch.
examples.zh: 我奶奶把她的舊胸針送給了我。

examples.en: The brooch shaped like a butterfly caught my eye.
examples.zh: 那枚蝴蝶形狀的胸針吸引了我的目光。

examples.en: The hen watched over her brood of chicks.
examples.zh: 母雞照看著牠的一窩小雞。

examples.en: A brood of ducklings followed the mother to the pond.
examples.zh: 一窩小鴨跟著母鴨走向池塘。

examples.en: She has a large brood to feed every evening.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都要餵飽一大群孩子。

examples.en: He tends to brood over small mistakes.
examples.zh: 他常為小錯誤悶悶不樂。

examples.en: Don't brood about the test result any longer.
examples.zh: 別再為考試結果煩惱了。

examples.en: The hens brood in the warm corner of the barn.
examples.zh: 母雞在穀倉溫暖的角落孵蛋。

examples.en: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
examples.zh: 他擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: She raised one brow and looked at me.
examples.zh: 她挑起一邊眉毛看著我。

examples.en: We stopped at the brow of the hill to rest.
examples.zh: 我們在山頂停下來休息。

examples.en: The farmer called the angry bull a brute.
examples.zh: 農夫把那頭發怒的公牛稱為野獸。

examples.en: He was a brute who shouted at everyone.
examples.zh: 他是個對每個人大吼大叫的粗暴傢伙。

examples.en: The movie shows a brute who learns to be kind.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個學會溫柔待人的粗魯男人。

examples.en: They moved the rock by brute force.
examples.zh: 他們靠蠻力搬動了那塊石頭。

examples.en: It was brute luck that we caught the last train.
examples.zh: 我們趕上末班車純粹是運氣。

examples.en: Brute strength alone will not win this game.
examples.zh: 光靠蠻力是贏不了這場比賽的。

examples.en: A buck with large antlers stood in the field.
examples.zh: 一隻長著大鹿角的公鹿站在田野裡。

examples.en: The ticket for the evening concert cost me ten bucks.
examples.zh: 這場晚間音樂會的門票花了我十美元。

examples.en: A young buck ran across the road at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明時一隻年輕的公鹿跑過馬路。

examples.en: The horse began to buck and threw the rider.
examples.zh: 那匹馬開始猛然跳躍，把騎士摔了下來。

examples.en: Few people dare to buck the system.
examples.zh: 很少有人敢違抗體制。

examples.en: The old truck bucked as it climbed the hill.
examples.zh: 那輛老卡車爬坡時劇烈顛簸。

examples.en: The buckle on my belt broke yesterday.
examples.zh: 我皮帶上的扣環昨天壞了。

examples.en: She polished the silver buckle on her shoes.
examples.zh: 她把鞋子上的銀色扣環擦亮。

examples.en: A shiny buckle held the bag strap in place.
examples.zh: 一個閃亮的帶扣固定住袋子的背帶。

examples.en: Please buckle your seat belt before we leave.
examples.zh: 出發前請繫好你的安全帶。

examples.en: The metal bridge began to buckle under the heat.
examples.zh: 這座金屬橋在高溫下開始彎曲變形。

examples.en: His legs buckled after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，他的雙腿發軟。

examples.en: The trees act as a buffer against the strong wind.
examples.zh: 這些樹木能作為強風的屏障。

examples.en: Leave a time buffer in case the train is late.
examples.zh: 預留一些緩衝時間，以免火車誤點。

examples.en: The video keeps stopping because the buffer is empty.
examples.zh: 因為緩衝區是空的，影片一直停頓。

examples.en: Soft rubber can buffer the sound of footsteps.
examples.zh: 柔軟的橡膠能減弱腳步聲。

examples.en: Savings can buffer families against the impact of unexpected medical bills.
examples.zh: 積蓄能減輕突發醫療帳單對家庭造成的衝擊。

examples.en: The thick walls buffer the room from street noise.
examples.zh: 厚牆讓房間免受街上噪音的影響。

examples.en: There has been a build-up of traffic on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的車流逐漸增加。

examples.en: The build-up to the final game was exciting.
examples.zh: 決賽前的準備與宣傳過程令人興奮。

examples.en: Wash the pan to stop the build-up of grease.
examples.zh: 把鍋子洗乾淨，以免油垢累積。

examples.en: There was a bulge in his coat pocket.
examples.zh: 他的外套口袋鼓了起來。

examples.en: The mechanic found a dangerous bulge in the car's front tire.
examples.zh: 技師發現汽車的前輪輪胎有一處危險的凸起。

examples.en: She noticed a small bulge under the carpet.
examples.zh: 她注意到地毯下有個小小的隆起。

examples.en: His bag bulged with books and snacks.
examples.zh: 他的袋子被書和零食塞得鼓鼓的。

examples.en: The old wall began to bulge in the middle.
examples.zh: 那面舊牆中間開始凸出來。

examples.en: Her pockets bulged with shells from the beach.
examples.zh: 她的口袋裡塞滿了從海灘撿來的貝殼，鼓鼓的。

examples.en: People hid in a bunker during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，人們躲進了一座地下避難所。

examples.en: The old bunker now serves as a museum.
examples.zh: 那座舊地下碉堡現在是一座博物館。

examples.en: His golf ball landed in the bunker beside the green.
examples.zh: 他的高爾夫球掉進了果嶺旁的沙坑。

examples.en: The bureaucratic process took almost three months.
examples.zh: 那套繁瑣的官僚流程花了將近三個月。

examples.en: Many people dislike bureaucratic rules at government offices.
examples.zh: 許多人不喜歡政府機關裡繁瑣的規定。

examples.en: The company became slow and bureaucratic as it grew.
examples.zh: 這間公司隨著規模擴大，變得遲緩又官僚。

examples.en: Be careful not to bust the lock.
examples.zh: 小心別把鎖弄壞了。

examples.en: She busted her favorite mug while washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 她洗碗時弄壞了自己最喜歡的馬克杯。

examples.en: Police busted a gang of thieves last night.
examples.zh: 警方昨晚破獲了一個竊盜集團。

examples.en: A marble bust of the writer stands in the hall.
examples.zh: 大廳裡立著那位作家的大理石半身像。

examples.en: The tailor measured the bust of the dress.
examples.zh: 裁縫師量了洋裝的胸圍。

examples.en: The housing boom ended in a sudden bust.
examples.zh: 房市的繁榮突然以崩盤收場。

examples.en: One byte is made up of eight bits.
examples.zh: 一個位元組由八個位元組成。

examples.en: The file is only a few bytes in size.
examples.zh: 這個檔案只有幾個位元組大。

examples.en: In ASCII, each letter takes up one byte of memory.
examples.zh: 在 ASCII 編碼中，每個字母佔用一個位元組的記憶體。

examples.en: A small cactus sits on my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌上放著一盆小小的仙人掌。

examples.en: The cactus has sharp spines to protect itself.
examples.zh: 仙人掌有尖刺來保護自己。

examples.en: This cactus only needs water once a month.
examples.zh: 這株仙人掌一個月只需要澆一次水。

senses.zh: 計算過的；深思熟慮的；故意的

examples.en: It was a calculated risk to open the shop here.
examples.zh: 在這裡開店是一項經過盤算的風險。

examples.en: Her calm answer was carefully calculated to avoid upsetting the audience.
examples.zh: 她冷靜的回答經過仔細斟酌，以免讓聽眾不悅。

examples.en: The mayor made a calculated decision to wait.
examples.zh: 市長經過審慎考量，決定等待。

senses.zh: 精於算計的；老謀深算的

examples.en: The calculating salesman never told us the full price.
examples.zh: 那位精於算計的業務員從沒告訴我們完整價格。

examples.en: She gave him a calculating look across the table.
examples.zh: 她隔著桌子對他投以算計的眼神。

examples.en: He was a calculating player who waited for his chance.
examples.zh: 他是個工於心計的選手，耐心等待機會。

examples.en: The calf stood up on shaky legs.
examples.zh: 那隻小牛用顫抖的腿站了起來。

examples.en: The farmer fed the newborn calf with milk.
examples.zh: 農夫用牛奶餵食剛出生的小牛。

examples.en: I felt pain in my left calf after the run.
examples.zh: 跑步後，我的左小腿肚覺得痠痛。

examples.en: The campaigner gave a speech about clean air.
examples.zh: 那位活動人士發表了關於清新空氣的演說。

examples.en: She is a well-known campaigner for animal rights.
examples.zh: 她是知名的動物權益倡議者。

examples.en: Campaigners gathered at the park to plant trees.
examples.zh: 倡議人士聚集在公園種樹。

examples.en: An old cannon stands at the entrance of the fort.
examples.zh: 一門古老的大砲立在堡壘入口。

examples.en: The cannon was fired once a day at noon.
examples.zh: 這門大砲每天中午會發射一次。

examples.en: Tourists took pictures next to the cannon.
examples.zh: 遊客在大砲旁拍照。

examples.en: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrate.
examples.zh: 米飯和麵包富含碳水化合物。

examples.en: Athletes eat more carbohydrate before a big race.
examples.zh: 運動員在大型比賽前會多吃碳水化合物。

examples.en: Our body uses carbohydrate as a main source of energy.
examples.zh: 我們的身體把碳水化合物當作主要的能量來源。

examples.en: She gently caressed the sleeping baby's cheek.
examples.zh: 她輕輕撫摸熟睡嬰兒的臉頰。

examples.en: The warm wind seemed to caress her face.
examples.zh: 暖風彷彿輕拂著她的臉。

examples.en: He likes to caress the cat's soft fur.
examples.zh: 他喜歡撫摸貓咪柔軟的毛。

examples.en: The baby smiled at her mother's gentle caress.
examples.zh: 寶寶對著媽媽輕柔的撫摸微笑。

examples.en: A soft caress calmed the nervous dog.
examples.zh: 輕輕的撫摸讓緊張的狗安靜下來。

examples.en: She felt the caress of the evening breeze.
examples.zh: 她感受到傍晚微風的輕拂。

examples.en: She gave her mother a pink carnation on Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 母親節那天，她送給媽媽一朵粉紅色康乃馨。

examples.en: The shop sells red and white carnations.
examples.zh: 這家店賣紅色和白色的康乃馨。

examples.en: A single carnation stood in the small glass vase.
examples.zh: 一朵康乃馨插在小玻璃花瓶裡。

examples.en: The children sang a carol at the school party.
examples.zh: 孩子們在學校的派對上唱了一首聖誕頌歌。

examples.en: We heard a carol coming from the church.
examples.zh: 我們聽見教堂傳來聖誕頌歌聲。

examples.en: My favorite carol is played every December.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的頌歌每年十二月都會播放。

examples.en: Large carp swam slowly in the pond.
examples.zh: 大鯉魚在池塘裡緩緩游動。

examples.en: We fed bread to the carp in the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園裡餵鯉魚吃麵包。

examples.en: My grandfather caught a big carp this morning.
examples.zh: 我爺爺今天早上釣到一條大鯉魚。

examples.en: He likes to carp about small things.
examples.zh: 他老愛為小事抱怨。

examples.en: Stop carping about the rules and just try.
examples.zh: 別再對規則挑三揀四，試試看吧。

examples.en: The coach never carps at his players.
examples.zh: 教練從不對球員吹毛求疵。

examples.en: The oil cartel agreed to cut production.
examples.zh: 石油卡特爾同意減少產量。

examples.en: Officials are investigating a price-fixing cartel involving several large shipping companies.
examples.zh: 官員正在調查一個涉及數家大型航運公司、操縱價格的聯合壟斷組織。

examples.en: A cartel can keep prices high for consumers.
examples.zh: 卡特爾可能讓消費者長期面對高價。

examples.en: The caste system divided society into groups.
examples.zh: 種姓制度把社會分成不同的群體。

examples.en: She wrote an essay about caste in history.
examples.zh: 她寫了一篇關於歷史上種姓制度的文章。

examples.en: In some places, people are judged by their caste.
examples.zh: 在某些地方，人們會依種姓被評價。

examples.en: The school hired a catering company for the party.
examples.zh: 學校為派對聘請了一家外燴公司提供餐飲。

examples.en: Her catering business grew quickly after the wedding season.
examples.zh: 婚禮旺季之後，她的外燴生意迅速成長。

examples.en: Catering for forty guests takes careful planning.
examples.zh: 為四十位賓客準備餐點需要仔細規劃。

examples.en: The cavalry rode across the field at dawn.
examples.zh: 騎兵隊在黎明時騎馬越過原野。

examples.en: A museum display shows old cavalry uniforms.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了舊時的騎兵制服。

examples.en: Cavalry once played a key role in many battles.
examples.zh: 騎兵曾在許多戰役中扮演關鍵角色。

examples.en: Both sides agreed to a ceasefire after weeks of talks.
examples.zh: 雙方在談判數週後同意停火。

examples.en: The ceasefire gave families time to return home safely.
examples.zh: 停火讓家庭有時間平安返家。

examples.en: Leaders hope the ceasefire will last until the winter ends.
examples.zh: 領袖們希望停火能持續到冬天結束。

examples.en: She is a celebrated author known around the world.
examples.zh: 她是享譽全球的著名作家。

examples.en: The celebrated chef opened a new restaurant downtown.
examples.zh: 這位著名的主廚在市中心開了一家新餐廳。

examples.en: Our town is celebrated for its beautiful old bridge.
examples.zh: 我們的小鎮以美麗的古橋聞名。

examples.en: We celebrated my sister's birthday at a small café.
examples.zh: 我們在一家小咖啡館慶祝我姊姊的生日。

examples.en: The whole class celebrated after the final exam ended.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，全班都在慶祝。

examples.en: They celebrated their tenth anniversary with a trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 他們以一趟日本之旅慶祝結婚十週年。

examples.en: We keep potatoes and onions in the cellar.
examples.zh: 我們把馬鈴薯和洋蔥存放在地窖裡。

examples.en: The old house has a cool, dark cellar.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有個涼爽昏暗的地下室。

examples.en: He took a bottle of wine from the cellar for dinner.
examples.zh: 他從酒窖拿了一瓶酒來配晚餐。

examples.en: She has played the cello since she was eight.
examples.zh: 她從八歲就開始拉大提琴。

examples.en: The cello sounds deep and warm in a small hall.
examples.zh: 在小廳裡，大提琴的聲音低沉而溫暖。

examples.en: My brother carries his cello to school every Monday.
examples.zh: 我哥哥每週一都把大提琴帶去學校。

examples.en: The teacher challenged us to solve the puzzle in five minutes.
examples.zh: 老師要我們挑戰在五分鐘內解開這道謎題。

examples.en: Nobody challenged his decision at the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議上沒有人質疑他的決定。

examples.en: She challenged her cousin to a game of chess.
examples.zh: 她向表哥下戰帖，要和他下一盤西洋棋。

senses.zh: 有障礙的；面臨困難的；受到考驗的

examples.en: The school has special programs for physically challenged students.
examples.zh: 學校為身體有障礙的學生提供特殊課程。

examples.en: Many small shops are financially challenged this year.
examples.zh: 今年許多小店都面臨財務困難。

examples.en: He felt challenged by the difficult new project.
examples.zh: 他覺得這個困難的新專案讓自己受到考驗。

examples.en: The young challenger beat the champion in three sets.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的挑戰者以三盤擊敗了冠軍。

examples.en: Our company faces a new challenger in the phone market.
examples.zh: 我們公司在手機市場面臨新的挑戰者。

examples.en: The challenger will play the final game on Saturday.
examples.zh: 挑戰者將在星期六進行決賽。

examples.en: This math test was challenging but fair.
examples.zh: 這次數學考試有難度，但很公平。

examples.en: She took a challenging job at a foreign company.
examples.zh: 她在一家外商公司接下了一份具挑戰性的工作。

examples.en: It was a challenging hike for beginners.
examples.zh: 對初學者來說，這是一趟有挑戰性的健行。

examples.en: He is challenging the decision in court.
examples.zh: 他正在法庭上對這項決定提出質疑。

examples.en: They are challenging each other to a swimming race.
examples.zh: 他們正互相挑戰比賽游泳。

examples.en: Students are challenging the old rules about uniforms.
examples.zh: 學生們正在質疑有關制服的舊規定。

examples.en: My lips are chapped from the cold wind.
examples.zh: 我的嘴唇被冷風吹得乾裂。

examples.en: Put some cream on your chapped hands before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前在你乾裂的手上擦點乳霜。

examples.en: His cheeks were red and chapped after the ski trip.
examples.zh: 滑雪旅行後，他的臉頰又紅又乾裂。

examples.en: We cooked the fish over charcoal at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊用木炭烤魚。

examples.en: The art student drew a portrait with charcoal.
examples.zh: 這位美術系學生用炭筆畫了一幅肖像。

examples.en: She wore a charcoal jacket to the interview.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件炭灰色外套去面試。

examples.en: The museum has a model of an ancient chariot.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有一輛古代戰車的模型。

examples.en: Two horses pulled the chariot around the track.
examples.zh: 兩匹馬拉著戰車繞著賽道跑。

examples.en: In the movie, the hero rides a golden chariot.
examples.zh: 電影裡，主角駕著一輛金色馬車。

examples.en: The school club wrote a charter with clear rules.
examples.zh: 學校社團寫了一份規則明確的章程。

examples.en: The city received its charter in the year 1700.
examples.zh: 這座城市在一七〇〇年獲得特許狀。

examples.en: The airline arranged a charter for our entire class.
examples.zh: 航空公司為我們全班安排了一趟包機。

senses.zh: 包租(船、飛機等)；特許設立

examples.en: They chartered a boat to see the whales.
examples.zh: 他們包了一艘船去看鯨魚。

examples.en: Our travel agency can charter a bus for the group.
examples.zh: 我們的旅行社可以為團體包租一輛遊覽車。

examples.en: The government chartered a new bank last year.
examples.zh: 政府去年特許設立了一家新銀行。

senses.zh: 閒聊；喋喋不休；嘰嘰喳喳聲

examples.en: The classroom was full of chatter before the bell rang.
examples.zh: 上課鈴響前，教室裡充滿了閒聊聲。

examples.en: I could hear the chatter of birds outside.
examples.zh: 我聽得到外面鳥兒的嘰嘰喳喳聲。

examples.en: Their endless chatter made it hard to study.
examples.zh: 他們沒完沒了的聊天聲讓人很難讀書。

examples.en: The children chattered all the way to the zoo.
examples.zh: 孩子們一路上都嘰嘰喳喳聊到動物園。

examples.en: Her teeth chattered in the cold water.
examples.zh: 她的牙齒在冷水中不停打顫。

examples.en: Stop chattering with your classmates and finish your homework.
examples.zh: 別再和同學閒聊了，把功課寫完。

examples.en: He wrote a check from his checkbook to pay the rent.
examples.zh: 他填寫了支票簿裡的一張支票來付房租。

examples.en: My grandfather still keeps a checkbook in his desk.
examples.zh: 我爺爺書桌裡還放著一本支票簿。

examples.en: She forgot her checkbook, so she paid by card.
examples.zh: 她忘了帶支票簿，所以改用卡付款。

examples.en: She checked her bag twice before leaving home.
examples.zh: 她出門前把包包檢查了兩次。

examples.en: The doctor checked his heartbeat carefully with a stethoscope.
examples.zh: 醫生用聽診器仔細檢查了他的心跳。

examples.en: I checked the box next to my name.
examples.zh: 我在自己名字旁的方框打了勾。

examples.en: He wore a checked shirt to the picnic.
examples.zh: 他穿著格子襯衫去野餐。

examples.en: The checked tablecloth made the kitchen look cheerful.
examples.zh: 格子桌巾讓廚房看起來充滿歡樂氣氛。

examples.en: My mother bought a checked scarf for me.
examples.zh: 我媽媽買了一條格子圍巾給我。

examples.en: Add one red chilli to make the soup spicy.
examples.zh: 加一根紅辣椒讓湯變辣。

examples.en: He cannot eat chilli because it hurts his stomach.
examples.zh: 他不能吃辣椒，因為會讓他胃痛。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its chilli sauce.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳以辣椒醬聞名。

examples.en: The carpenter used a chisel to shape the wood.
examples.zh: 木匠用鑿子把木頭修整成形。

examples.en: He tapped the chisel gently with a hammer.
examples.zh: 他用鎚子輕輕敲打鑿子。

examples.en: A sharp chisel makes the work much easier.
examples.zh: 一把鋒利的鑿子能讓工作輕鬆許多。

examples.en: The artist chiseled a face into the stone.
examples.zh: 藝術家在石頭上鑿出一張臉。

examples.en: Workers chisel the old tiles off the floor.
examples.zh: 工人們把舊瓷磚從地板上鑿掉。

examples.en: He chiseled his name into the wooden bench.
examples.zh: 他把自己的名字刻在木頭長椅上。

examples.en: Chuck the old magazines in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 把舊雜誌丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: He chucked his bag onto the sofa and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把背包往沙發上一扔，然後坐下。

examples.en: She chucked the baby under the chin and smiled.
examples.zh: 她輕拍寶寶的下巴並微笑。

examples.en: We bought chuck for the beef stew.
examples.zh: 我們買了牛肩頸肉來燉牛肉。

examples.en: Tighten the chuck before you start the drill.
examples.zh: 開始鑽孔前先鎖緊夾頭。

examples.en: The butcher cut a nice piece of chuck for us.
examples.zh: 肉販為我們切了一塊漂亮的牛肩頸肉。

examples.en: He chuckled when he read the funny note.
examples.zh: 他讀到那張有趣的紙條時輕輕笑了起來。

examples.en: The audience chuckled at the clown's tricks.
examples.zh: 觀眾被小丑的把戲逗得輕笑。

examples.en: My grandfather chuckles every time he hears that song.
examples.zh: 我爺爺每次聽到那首歌都會輕笑。

examples.en: She gave a soft chuckle and shook her head.
examples.zh: 她輕輕笑了一聲並搖搖頭。

examples.en: There was a chuckle from the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房間後方傳來一聲輕笑。

examples.en: His joke got a chuckle from everyone.
examples.zh: 他的笑話讓每個人都輕笑了一下。

examples.en: The circumference of the circle is about thirty centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個圓的周長大約是三十公分。

examples.en: Students learned how to measure the circumference of a ball.
examples.zh: 學生們學習如何測量球的周長。

examples.en: The circumference of the lake is nearly five kilometers.
examples.zh: 這座湖的周長將近五公里。

examples.en: He used a clamp to hold the board in place.
examples.zh: 他用夾鉗把木板固定住。

examples.en: The bike has a small clamp on the seat.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的座墊上有個小固定夾。

examples.en: Please bring a clamp from the toolbox.
examples.zh: 請從工具箱拿一個夾鉗過來。

examples.en: Clamp the paper to the table so it won't move.
examples.zh: 把紙夾在桌上，這樣它就不會移動。

examples.en: She clamped her hand over her mouth.
examples.zh: 她用手緊緊摀住嘴巴。

examples.en: The mechanic clamped the pipe before cutting it.
examples.zh: 技師在切斷管子前先把它夾住。

examples.en: The whole clan gathered for the New Year dinner.
examples.zh: 全族的人都聚在一起吃年夜飯。

examples.en: Each clan in the village had its own traditions.
examples.zh: 村裡每個氏族都有自己的傳統。

examples.en: My uncle is the oldest man in our clan.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是我們家族裡年紀最大的男性。

examples.en: Cleanse your face gently with warm water.
examples.zh: 用溫水輕輕清潔你的臉。

examples.en: The doctor cleansed the wound before covering it.
examples.zh: 醫生在包紮前先把傷口洗淨。

examples.en: A short walk can help cleanse your mind.
examples.zh: 短暫散步有助於淨化心靈。

examples.en: The class organized a cleanup of the school yard.
examples.zh: 全班籌辦了校園庭院的清掃活動。

examples.en: After the party, the cleanup took two hours.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，清理花了兩個小時。

examples.en: The city started a river cleanup this spring.
examples.zh: 市政府今年春天展開了河川清理工作。

senses.zh: 林間空地；清除；票據交換

examples.en: We set up our tent in a small clearing.
examples.zh: 我們在一小塊林間空地搭起帳篷。

examples.en: The clearing of snow took the workers all morning.
examples.zh: 清除積雪花了工人整個早上。

examples.en: The bank handles the clearing of checks every day.
examples.zh: 銀行負責處理支票的交換作業。

examples.en: She is clearing the table after dinner.
examples.zh: 她正在晚餐後收拾餐桌。

examples.en: Workers are clearing the road after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨後，工人們正在清理道路。

examples.en: He is clearing his throat before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，他正在清嗓子。

examples.en: She clenched her fists and tried to stay calm.
examples.zh: 她握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。

examples.en: He clenched his teeth during the long exam.
examples.zh: 漫長的考試期間，他一直咬緊牙關。

examples.en: The child clenched the toy tightly in her hand.
examples.zh: 小女孩把玩具緊緊握在手裡。

examples.en: Our team clinched the title with a late goal.
examples.zh: 我們隊憑藉比賽尾聲的一記進球，鎖定了冠軍。

examples.en: She clinched the deal after a short meeting.
examples.zh: 她在一場簡短會議後敲定了這筆交易。

examples.en: A strong interview helped him clinch the job.
examples.zh: 一場出色的面試幫助他拿到了這份工作。

examples.en: The bank is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
examples.zh: 銀行在星期日及國定假日休息。

examples.en: Keep the windows closed during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間請把窗戶關好。

examples.en: The road is closed because of construction.
examples.zh: 這條路因施工而封閉。

examples.en: She closed the door quietly behind her.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地把門關上。

examples.en: The store closed early because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 商店因颱風提早打烊。

examples.en: He closed his eyes and listened to the music.
examples.zh: 他閉上眼睛聽音樂。

examples.en: She found a four-leaf clover in the garden.
examples.zh: 她在花園裡找到一株四葉幸運草。

examples.en: Bees love the white clover growing near the path.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂喜歡長在小徑旁的白三葉草。

examples.en: Farmers plant clover to feed their cows.
examples.zh: 農夫種植三葉草來餵牛。

examples.en: The little boy clutched his mother's hand.
examples.zh: 小男孩緊抓著媽媽的手。

examples.en: She clutched her bag as she walked through the crowd.
examples.zh: 她穿過人群時緊抓著她的包包。

examples.en: He clutched the rail to keep from falling.
examples.zh: 他緊抓著欄杆以免跌倒。

senses.zh: 離合器；手拿包；關鍵時刻

examples.en: Press the clutch before you change gears.
examples.zh: 換檔之前要先踩離合器。

examples.en: She carried a small silver clutch to the party.
examples.zh: 她帶了一個銀色小手拿包去派對。

examples.en: The striker is calm in the clutch.
examples.zh: 這位前鋒在關鍵時刻很冷靜。

examples.en: We drove along the coastal road all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午沿著海岸公路開車。

examples.en: Many coastal towns depend on tourism for jobs and income.
examples.zh: 許多沿海城鎮仰賴觀光業提供工作機會與收入。

examples.en: Coastal areas often get strong winds in autumn.
examples.zh: 沿海地區秋天常常有強風。

examples.en: The pilot invited the boy to see the cockpit.
examples.zh: 機師邀請那個男孩參觀駕駛艙。

examples.en: Many switches covered the walls of the cockpit.
examples.zh: 駕駛艙的牆面布滿了許多開關。

examples.en: The race driver climbed into the cockpit and fastened his belt.
examples.zh: 賽車手爬進駕駛座並繫好安全帶。

examples.en: A moth slowly emerged from its cocoon on the branch.
examples.zh: 一隻蛾慢慢從樹枝上的繭中羽化而出。

examples.en: The worm spun a cocoon on the branch.
examples.zh: 那隻蟲在樹枝上吐絲結繭。

examples.en: She wrapped herself in a warm cocoon of blankets.
examples.zh: 她把自己裹在溫暖的毯子裡。

examples.en: Parents often cocoon their children from bad news.
examples.zh: 父母常常讓孩子與壞消息隔絕。

examples.en: He cocooned himself in a thick coat.
examples.zh: 他把自己裹在一件厚外套裡。

examples.en: The soft sofa cocooned her while she read.
examples.zh: 她看書時，柔軟的沙發將她整個包住。

examples.en: A coil of rope lay on the deck.
examples.zh: 甲板上放著一捲繩子。

examples.en: The heater has a metal coil inside.
examples.zh: 這台電暖器裡面有一組金屬線圈。

examples.en: The electrician placed a coil of wire beside the toolbox.
examples.zh: 電工把一捲電線放在工具箱旁邊。

examples.en: The snake coiled itself around a branch.
examples.zh: 那條蛇盤繞在一根樹枝上。

examples.en: She coiled the garden hose and put it away.
examples.zh: 她把園藝水管捲起來收好。

examples.en: Smoke coiled slowly up from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙從煙囪裡緩緩盤旋而上。

examples.en: My birthday coincides with the school festival this year.
examples.zh: 我今年的生日剛好與校慶同一天。

examples.en: Their opinions rarely coincide with each other.
examples.zh: 他們的意見很少一致。

examples.en: The sale will coincide with the opening of the new store.
examples.zh: 特賣會將與新店開幕同時舉行。

examples.en: She collected stamps from many countries when she was a child.
examples.zh: 她小時候收集了許多國家的郵票。

examples.en: The teacher collected our homework on Friday.
examples.zh: 老師在星期五收了我們的功課。

examples.en: He collected his package from the post office.
examples.zh: 他去郵局領了他的包裹。

examples.en: She stayed calm and collected during the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面試中保持冷靜沉著。

examples.en: The library has a copy of the poet's collected works.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一本那位詩人的作品集。

examples.en: The collected data will be shared with the class.
examples.zh: 蒐集到的資料將與全班分享。

examples.en: Two bikes collided at the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 兩輛腳踏車在街角相撞。

examples.en: The ball collided with the window and broke it.
examples.zh: 球撞上窗戶並把它撞破了。

examples.en: Their business interests sometimes collide when they compete for the same customers.
examples.zh: 當他們爭取同一批顧客時，彼此的商業利益有時會發生衝突。

examples.en: The colonel greeted the soldiers at the gate.
examples.zh: 上校在大門口迎接士兵們。

examples.en: My grandfather retired as a colonel in the army.
examples.zh: 我爺爺以陸軍上校的身分退役。

examples.en: The colonel gave a short speech at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 上校在典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

examples.en: The singer made a comeback after five quiet years.
examples.zh: 這位歌手沉寂五年後東山再起。

examples.en: Our team staged a great comeback in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊在下半場上演了精彩的逆轉。

examples.en: She had a clever comeback ready for his joke.
examples.zh: 她對他的玩笑準備好了一句機智的回應。

senses.zh: 落差；地位下降；令人失望的事

examples.en: Moving into a tiny room was a big comedown for him.
examples.zh: 搬進小房間對他來說是一大落差。

examples.en: After the exciting trip, school felt like a comedown.
examples.zh: 精彩的旅行之後，上學讓人覺得很失落。

examples.en: Losing the title was a real comedown for the team.
examples.zh: 失去冠軍頭銜對球隊而言是真正的挫敗。

examples.en: The town built a statue to commemorate the founder.
examples.zh: 小鎮蓋了一座雕像來紀念創辦人。

examples.en: We held a ceremony to commemorate the school's hundredth year.
examples.zh: 我們舉辦典禮來紀念學校一百週年。

examples.en: This stamp was made to commemorate the Olympic Games.
examples.zh: 這枚郵票是為紀念奧運而製作的。

examples.en: The meeting will commence at nine o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 會議將在九點整開始。

examples.en: Classes at the new language school commence in early September.
examples.zh: 新語言學校的課程將於九月初開始。

examples.en: The company plans to commence work on the bridge next month.
examples.zh: 公司計畫下個月開始動工建橋。

examples.en: The principal commended the students for their hard work.
examples.zh: 校長表揚學生們的努力。

examples.en: The manager commended her on the successful project.
examples.zh: 經理稱讚她成功完成專案。

examples.en: I commend this restaurant to anyone who loves seafood.
examples.zh: 我向任何愛吃海鮮的人推薦這家餐廳。

examples.en: The police commissioner spoke to reporters this morning.
examples.zh: 警察首長今天早上對記者發表談話。

examples.en: A new commissioner was chosen to lead the sports league.
examples.zh: 運動聯盟選出了一位新的會長來領導。

examples.en: The commissioner approved the plan for the new park.
examples.zh: 委員核准了新公園的計畫。

examples.en: The apartment has a communal garden for all residents.
examples.zh: 這棟公寓有供所有住戶使用的公共花園。

examples.en: Students share a communal kitchen on each floor.
examples.zh: 學生們每層樓共用一間廚房。

examples.en: The village holds a communal dinner every autumn.
examples.zh: 村子每年秋天都會舉辦社區聚餐。

examples.en: Many elderly people need companionship more than medicine.
examples.zh: 許多老人比起藥物，更需要陪伴。

examples.en: The dog gave him companionship during the long winter.
examples.zh: 在漫長的冬天裡，這隻狗給了他陪伴。

examples.en: She joined the club for friendship and companionship.
examples.zh: 她加入社團是為了友誼與陪伴。

examples.en: The train compartment was clean and quiet.
examples.zh: 火車車廂內的隔間又乾淨又安靜。

examples.en: Put your bag in the overhead compartment.
examples.zh: 把你的包包放進頭頂的置物櫃。

examples.en: The fridge has a separate compartment for vegetables.
examples.zh: 冰箱有一個專門放蔬菜的隔層。

senses.zh: 令人信服的；引人入勝的

examples.en: She gave a compelling reason for changing the plan.
examples.zh: 她為更改計畫提出了令人信服的理由。

examples.en: The movie tells a compelling story about friendship.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述了一個引人入勝的友誼故事。

examples.en: There is compelling evidence that exercise improves sleep.
examples.zh: 有強而有力的證據顯示運動能改善睡眠。

examples.en: Two competing companies sell similar phones at very different prices.
examples.zh: 兩家互相競爭的公司以差異很大的價格販售類似的手機。

examples.en: The competing teams shook hands after the game.
examples.zh: 相互競爭的隊伍在比賽後握了手。

examples.en: She struggled to balance the competing demands of work and family.
examples.zh: 她努力兼顧工作與家庭之間相互衝突的需求。

examples.en: Twenty students are competing for the top prize.
examples.zh: 二十名學生正在爭奪首獎。

examples.en: Our school is competing in the national contest.
examples.zh: 我們學校正在參加全國比賽。

examples.en: Small shops are competing with large supermarkets.
examples.zh: 小商店正在與大型超市競爭。

examples.en: The bike frame is made of a composite material.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是以複合材料製成的。

examples.en: The report gives a composite picture of the city's growth.
examples.zh: 這份報告呈現了這座城市成長的綜合面貌。

examples.en: The police released a composite sketch of the thief.
examples.zh: 警方公布了竊賊的合成畫像。

examples.en: The panel is a composite of glass and plastic.
examples.zh: 這塊面板是玻璃與塑膠的合成物。

examples.en: This score is a composite of three different tests.
examples.zh: 這個分數是三項不同測驗的綜合結果。

examples.en: Engineers use a light composite to build the boat.
examples.zh: 工程師用輕量的複合材料來製造這艘船。

examples.en: You can compress the files to save space.
examples.zh: 你可以壓縮檔案來節省空間。

examples.en: She compressed her clothes into a small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她把衣服壓緊，塞進一個小行李箱。

examples.en: The teacher compressed the long story into one paragraph.
examples.zh: 老師把長篇故事濃縮成一段。

examples.en: The nurse put a cold compress on his forehead.
examples.zh: 護理師把冷敷布敷在他的額頭上。

examples.en: A warm compress can ease the pain.
examples.zh: 溫熱的敷布有助於減輕疼痛。

examples.en: She held a damp compress against her sore eye.
examples.zh: 她把濕敷布按在疼痛的眼睛上。

examples.en: Cloud computing lets us store files online.
examples.zh: 雲端運算讓我們可以把檔案存在網路上。

examples.en: He is studying computing at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 他在台北的一所大學攻讀電腦科學。

examples.en: The company spends a lot on high-speed computing.
examples.zh: 這間公司在高速運算上花了很多錢。

examples.en: Every plan has its pros and cons.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有優點和缺點。

examples.en: The offer turned out to be a con.
examples.zh: 那項優惠結果是個騙局。

examples.en: Please list the pros and cons of living downtown.
examples.zh: 請列出住在市中心的優缺點。

examples.en: Do not let anyone con you out of your money.
examples.zh: 別讓任何人騙走你的錢。

examples.en: The seller conned several tourists at the market.
examples.zh: 那名賣家在市場裡騙了好幾位遊客。

examples.en: He felt foolish after being conned online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上被騙後覺得自己很傻。

examples.en: His conceit made it hard for him to make friends.
examples.zh: 他的自負讓他很難交到朋友。

examples.en: She spoke about her success without any conceit.
examples.zh: 她談起自己的成就時毫不自大。

examples.en: Too much conceit can stop you from learning.
examples.zh: 過度自負會讓你無法學習。

examples.en: The mayor's remarks drew widespread condemnation from parents at the meeting.
examples.zh: 市長的發言在會議上招來家長們的廣泛譴責。

examples.en: The school voiced its condemnation of cheating.
examples.zh: 學校表達了對作弊行為的譴責。

examples.en: There was public condemnation of the company's unsafe practices.
examples.zh: 大眾對這間公司不安全的做法予以譴責。

examples.en: Health classes teach students how a condom helps prevent disease.
examples.zh: 健康教育課教學生保險套如何幫助預防疾病。

examples.en: You can buy a condom at most pharmacies.
examples.zh: 大多數藥局都買得到保險套。

examples.en: The nurse explained why using a condom is important.
examples.zh: 護理師說明了使用保險套的重要性。

examples.en: The teachers will confer before they decide the grades.
examples.zh: 老師們會先商議再決定成績。

examples.en: I need to confer with my manager about the budget.
examples.zh: 我需要和經理商量預算的事。

examples.en: The university will confer a degree on her next month.
examples.zh: 大學下個月將授予她學位。

examples.en: The configuration of the network took two hours.
examples.zh: 網路的設定花了兩個小時。

examples.en: Please check the configuration before you restart the computer.
examples.zh: 重新啟動電腦前，請先檢查設定。

examples.en: This room has a new seating configuration for the exam.
examples.zh: 這間教室為了考試換了新的座位配置。

examples.en: A congressional committee will review the new law.
examples.zh: 國會委員會將審查這項新法律。

examples.en: She works as a congressional assistant in Washington.
examples.zh: 她在華盛頓擔任國會助理。

examples.en: The congressional vote is scheduled for next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 國會的表決排定在下週二。

senses.zh: 男性國會議員（尤指美國眾議員）

examples.en: The congressman visited our school last week.
examples.zh: 那位國會議員上週來訪我們學校。

examples.en: Our class wrote a letter to a congressman.
examples.zh: 我們班寫了一封信給一位國會議員。

examples.en: The congressman answered questions from local residents.
examples.zh: 那位國會議員回答了當地居民的問題。

examples.en: He lost consciousness for a few seconds after falling.
examples.zh: 他跌倒後失去意識好幾秒。

examples.en: The video raised public consciousness about plastic waste.
examples.zh: 這支影片提升了大眾對塑膠垃圾的認知。

examples.en: She regained consciousness in the hospital after the operation.
examples.zh: 手術後，她在醫院裡恢復了意識。

examples.en: Considering the weather, we should stay home.
examples.zh: 考慮到天氣，我們應該待在家裡。

examples.en: She did well on the test, considering how little time she had.
examples.zh: 就她擁有的時間之少而言，她考得很好。

examples.en: Considering his age, he runs very fast.
examples.zh: 就他的年紀來說，他跑得很快。

examples.en: The company plans to consolidate its two offices.
examples.zh: 公司打算合併兩間辦公室。

examples.en: Regular review helps students consolidate what they learn.
examples.zh: 定期複習能幫助學生鞏固所學。

examples.en: The team worked hard to consolidate its lead.
examples.zh: 球隊努力鞏固自己的領先優勢。

examples.en: A consortium of schools built the new library together.
examples.zh: 幾所學校組成的聯盟共同興建了新圖書館。

examples.en: The consortium will meet next month to discuss funding.
examples.zh: 該聯盟下個月會開會討論資金。

examples.en: Several banks formed a consortium to support the project.
examples.zh: 幾家銀行組成財團來支持這項專案。

examples.en: The red sign is conspicuous from far away.
examples.zh: 那面紅色招牌從很遠的地方就很顯眼。

examples.en: He felt conspicuous in his bright orange jacket.
examples.zh: 他穿著亮橘色外套，覺得自己很引人注目。

examples.en: Her conspicuous absence from the final rehearsal worried her classmates.
examples.zh: 她缺席最後一次彩排一事引人注意，令同學們很擔心。

examples.en: The constable asked the tourists if they needed help.
examples.zh: 那位警員問遊客是否需要協助。

examples.en: A village constable knew everyone in town.
examples.zh: 村裡的警員認識鎮上的每個人。

examples.en: We asked a constable for directions to the station.
examples.zh: 我們向一位警員問往車站的路。

examples.en: The mayor visited every part of her constituency.
examples.zh: 市長走訪了她選區的每個角落。

examples.en: He listens closely to the needs of his constituency.
examples.zh: 他仔細傾聽選區選民的需求。

examples.en: This constituency has more than fifty thousand voters.
examples.zh: 這個選區有五萬多名選民。

examples.en: A constituent called the office to complain about the road.
examples.zh: 一位選民打電話到辦公室抱怨那條路。

examples.en: Water is the main constituent of milk.
examples.zh: 水是牛奶的主要成分。

examples.en: Each constituent of the machine must be tested.
examples.zh: 機器的每個組成部分都必須經過測試。

examples.en: The company sold off its constituent parts.
examples.zh: 那間公司把構成它的各個部門都賣掉了。

examples.en: Each constituent country has its own flag.
examples.zh: 每個組成國都有自己的旗幟。

examples.en: Scientists studied the constituent elements of the rock.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了那塊岩石的組成元素。

examples.en: A small budget can constrain what we are able to do.
examples.zh: 預算很少會限制我們能做的事。

examples.en: School rules should not constrain students' creativity in art classes.
examples.zh: 學校規則不該限制學生在美術課上的創造力。

examples.en: He felt constrained by his strict schedule.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己被緊湊的行程表所束縛。

examples.en: A consuming fear of failure kept him awake before the exam.
examples.zh: 強烈的失敗恐懼讓他在考試前無法入睡。

examples.en: She had a consuming passion for music.
examples.zh: 她對音樂懷有強烈的熱情。

examples.en: Her consuming curiosity led her to read every book on the subject.
examples.zh: 她強烈的好奇心促使她讀遍這個主題的每一本書。

examples.en: The test found a contaminant in the water.
examples.zh: 檢測在水中發現了汙染物。

examples.en: Filters remove any contaminant from the air.
examples.zh: 濾網會去除空氣中的任何汙染物。

examples.en: Even a tiny contaminant can ruin the experiment.
examples.zh: 就算是微量的雜質也可能毀掉實驗。

examples.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
examples.zh: 他靜靜地坐在湖邊沉思。

examples.en: After long contemplation, she chose to study abroad.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的考慮，她決定出國讀書。

examples.en: The garden is a good place for contemplation.
examples.zh: 這座花園是沉思的好地方。

examples.en: She is a strong contender for the gold medal.
examples.zh: 她是奪得金牌的有力競爭者。

examples.en: Three contenders entered the final round of the contest.
examples.zh: 三位競爭者進入了比賽的決賽。

examples.en: Our school is a serious contender in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 我們學校是演講比賽中實力堅強的競爭者。

examples.en: A warm meal at home gave him great contentment.
examples.zh: 在家吃頓熱騰騰的飯讓他十分滿足。

examples.en: She smiled with contentment as she read her book.
examples.zh: 她一邊讀書一邊滿足地微笑。

examples.en: Contentment does not depend on having a lot of money.
examples.zh: 知足並不取決於擁有多少錢。

examples.en: A large contingent of Taiwanese students joined the trip.
examples.zh: 一大群台灣學生參加了這趟旅行。

examples.en: Our contingent arrived at the stadium early.
examples.zh: 我們這一隊提早抵達了體育場。

examples.en: The Japanese contingent was the first to enter the hall.
examples.zh: 日本代表團是第一個進入大廳的。

examples.en: Our plans are contingent on the weather.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫要視天氣而定。

examples.en: The offer is contingent upon a good interview.
examples.zh: 這份工作機會取決於面試表現是否良好。

examples.en: Payment is contingent on the work being finished.
examples.zh: 付款以工作完成為條件。

examples.en: The two reports gave contradictory answers about the cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 這兩份報告對事故原因提出了互相矛盾的答案。

examples.en: His words and actions are completely contradictory.
examples.zh: 他的言語和行為完全相互矛盾。

examples.en: We heard contradictory news about the flight.
examples.zh: 我們聽到關於班機的消息互相矛盾。

senses.zh: 投稿人；捐贈者；促成因素

examples.en: She is a regular contributor to the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 她是校刊的固定投稿人。

examples.en: The museum thanked every contributor for their gifts.
examples.zh: 博物館感謝每一位捐贈者的捐贈。

examples.en: Exercise is a major contributor to good health.
examples.zh: 運動是促進健康的主要因素。

examples.en: She managed to contrive a way to meet him.
examples.zh: 她設法想出辦法見到他。

examples.en: The students contrived a plan to surprise their teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們策劃了一個要給老師驚喜的計畫。

examples.en: We contrived to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們想辦法在截止日前完成了專案。

examples.en: Several roads converge near the train station.
examples.zh: 幾條道路在火車站附近匯合。

examples.en: Fans converged on the stadium before the game.
examples.zh: 球迷在比賽前聚集到體育場。

examples.en: Our opinions began to converge after a long talk.
examples.zh: 經過長談之後，我們的意見開始趨於一致。

examples.en: Some people enjoy crowds; conversely, others avoid them.
examples.zh: 有些人喜歡人群；相反地，也有人避開人群。

examples.en: Prices rose in the city. Conversely, they fell in the country.
examples.zh: 城市的物價上漲，相反地，鄉下的物價下跌。

examples.en: Good sleep improves learning; conversely, poor sleep makes studying more difficult.
examples.zh: 睡得好能提升學習效果；反過來說，睡不好會讓讀書更吃力。

examples.en: He drove his red convertible along the coast.
examples.zh: 他開著紅色敞篷車沿著海岸行駛。

examples.en: My uncle bought a used convertible last summer.
examples.zh: 我叔叔去年夏天買了一輛二手敞篷車。

examples.en: We put the top down on the convertible and enjoyed the breeze.
examples.zh: 我們把敞篷車的車頂收起來，享受微風。

examples.en: This sofa is convertible into a bed.
examples.zh: 這張沙發可以變成一張床。
