examples.en: The company issued convertible bonds last year.
examples.zh: 這間公司去年發行了可轉換債券。

examples.en: A convertible currency can be exchanged for others.
examples.zh: 可兌換貨幣能和其他貨幣互相兌換。

examples.en: A convoy of trucks carried food to the village.
examples.zh: 一列卡車車隊把食物運到村子裡。

examples.en: The convoy stopped at a rest area for lunch.
examples.zh: 車隊在休息站停下來吃午餐。

examples.en: Several buses traveled together in a convoy.
examples.zh: 好幾輛公車組成車隊一起行駛。

examples.en: A cop helped us cross the busy street.
examples.zh: 一位警察協助我們穿越繁忙的馬路。

examples.en: The cop asked him to move his car.
examples.zh: 那位警察要他把車移開。

examples.en: My neighbor works as a cop in the city.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居在市區當警察。

examples.en: The host gave us a cordial welcome at the door.
examples.zh: 主人在門口熱情地歡迎我們。

examples.en: They have always had a cordial relationship.
examples.zh: 他們一直維持著友好的關係。

examples.en: Her cordial smile made the new students feel at ease.
examples.zh: 她親切的笑容讓新生感到自在。

examples.en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle.
examples.zh: 他把瓶子的軟木塞拔出來。

examples.en: The notice board is made of cork.
examples.zh: 這塊布告欄是用軟木做的。

examples.en: Please put the cork back after you pour the wine.
examples.zh: 倒完酒後，請把軟木塞塞回去。

examples.en: The medical corps sent doctors to the flooded area.
examples.zh: 醫療團派醫師前往淹水地區。

examples.en: She joined a drum and bugle corps at her school.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校的鼓號樂隊。

examples.en: A corps of volunteers cleaned the beach.
examples.zh: 一群志工把海灘打掃乾淨。

examples.en: The teacher made a correction on my essay.
examples.zh: 老師在我的作文上做了修改。

examples.en: The newspaper printed a correction the next day.
examples.zh: 報紙隔天刊登了更正啟事。

examples.en: Please hand in your corrections by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前交出你的訂正。

examples.en: Height and weight often correlate in children.
examples.zh: 孩童的身高與體重常常相關。

examples.en: Researchers found that sleep correlates with test scores.
examples.zh: 研究人員發現睡眠與考試成績有關聯。

examples.en: It is hard to correlate the two sets of data.
examples.zh: 很難把這兩組資料互相關聯起來。

examples.en: Height is a correlate of age in young children.
examples.zh: 在年幼的孩子身上，身高是和年齡相關的因素。

examples.en: Scientists studied a correlate of the disease.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了這種疾病的一個相關因素。

examples.en: Each variable has its own correlate in the second table.
examples.zh: 每個變數在第二張表中都有各自的對應項目。

examples.en: Salt water can corrode metal very quickly.
examples.zh: 鹽水會很快腐蝕金屬。

examples.en: The old pipes began to corrode after years of use.
examples.zh: 舊水管用了多年後開始腐蝕。

examples.en: Moisture can corrode the bike's metal parts if you leave it outside.
examples.zh: 如果把腳踏車放在外面，濕氣可能會腐蝕它的金屬零件。

examples.en: Scientists study cosmic rays from deep space.
examples.zh: 科學家研究來自外太空深處的宇宙射線。

examples.en: The telescope took a picture of a cosmic cloud.
examples.zh: 這台望遠鏡拍下了一片宇宙星雲的照片。

examples.en: The size of the universe is a cosmic mystery.
examples.zh: 宇宙究竟有多大，是個宇宙之謎。

senses.zh: 國際化的；世界性的；見多識廣的

examples.en: Taipei is a modern and cosmopolitan city.
examples.zh: 台北是一座現代又國際化的城市。

examples.en: She has a cosmopolitan view of the world.
examples.zh: 她對世界抱持著開闊的國際視野。

examples.en: The cosmopolitan crowd at the festival came from many countries.
examples.zh: 慶典上國際化的人群來自許多國家。

examples.en: The costing of the new building took several weeks.
examples.zh: 新大樓的成本核算花了好幾週。

examples.en: A detailed costing showed that we need more money.
examples.zh: 詳細的估價顯示我們需要更多資金。

examples.en: The accountant finished the costing before the meeting.
examples.zh: 會計師在會議前完成了成本核算。

examples.en: The councilor promised to repair the park.
examples.zh: 那位議員承諾要修繕公園。

examples.en: A local councilor spoke at our school.
examples.zh: 一位地方議員到我們學校演講。

examples.en: Residents wrote to the councilor about the noise.
examples.zh: 居民寫信給議員反映噪音問題。

examples.en: Turn the lid counterclockwise to open the jar.
examples.zh: 把蓋子逆時針轉就能打開罐子。

examples.en: The runners went counterclockwise around the track.
examples.zh: 跑者們沿著跑道逆時針跑。

examples.en: Turn the handle counterclockwise to open the bathroom window.
examples.zh: 逆時針轉動把手，就能打開浴室窗戶。

examples.en: The machine makes a counterclockwise turn before returning to its starting position.
examples.zh: 這台機器先逆時針轉動，再回到起始位置。

examples.en: Use a counterclockwise motion to loosen the screw.
examples.zh: 用逆時針的動作來鬆開螺絲。

examples.en: The counterclockwise path leads to the exit.
examples.zh: 逆時針方向的路徑通往出口。

examples.en: Countless stars shine in the sky on a clear night.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，天上有無數的星星閃耀。

examples.en: She has read countless books since she was a child.
examples.zh: 她從小就讀過無數的書。

examples.en: Countless people visit the night market every weekend.
examples.zh: 每個週末都有無數的人造訪夜市。

examples.en: The army leader took power in a coup.
examples.zh: 那名軍事領袖透過政變奪得了權力。

examples.en: Winning the contract was a real coup for the company.
examples.zh: 贏得那份合約對公司而言是一大成就。

examples.en: The coup surprised people around the world.
examples.zh: 那場政變讓全世界的人都很驚訝。

examples.en: A courier delivered the package to our door.
examples.zh: 一位快遞員把包裹送到我們家門口。

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign for the letter.
examples.zh: 快遞員請我在信件上簽收。

examples.en: We sent the original documents to the client by courier.
examples.zh: 我們用快遞把文件正本寄給客戶。

examples.en: Please courier the contract to our office this afternoon.
examples.zh: 請在今天下午把合約以快遞寄到我們辦公室。

examples.en: She couriered the gift to her friend in Japan.
examples.zh: 她把禮物用快遞寄給在日本的朋友。

examples.en: The documents were couriered overnight so they would arrive before the meeting.
examples.zh: 這些文件以隔日送達的快遞寄送，以便在會議前抵達。

examples.en: A thick covering of snow lay on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋頂上覆蓋著一層厚厚的雪。

examples.en: The table has a plastic covering to keep it clean.
examples.zh: 桌子上有一層塑膠罩保持乾淨。

examples.en: Put a covering over the bowl to keep out flies.
examples.zh: 在碗上蓋個東西，以免蒼蠅飛進去。

examples.en: Many collectors covet this rare stamp because of its unusual design.
examples.zh: 許多收藏家因為這張稀有郵票的獨特設計，而渴望擁有它。

examples.en: He secretly coveted his friend's new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他暗自渴望擁有朋友的新腳踏車。

examples.en: The coveted prize went to a student from our school.
examples.zh: 那個令人夢寐以求的獎項由我們學校的一位學生拿下。

senses.zh: 廢話；劣質品（口語，較粗俗）

examples.en: I am tired of listening to his crap.
examples.zh: 我聽膩了他的廢話。

examples.en: The toy broke in one day because it was crap.
examples.zh: 那個玩具品質很差，一天就壞了。

examples.en: Do not believe all the crap you read online.
examples.zh: 別相信你在網路上讀到的所有胡說八道。

examples.en: The old door began to creak when I pushed it.
examples.zh: 我一推那扇老舊的門，它就發出嘎吱聲。

examples.en: The stairs creak every time someone walks up.
examples.zh: 每次有人走上樓梯，階梯就嘎吱作響。

examples.en: The wooden chair creaked under his weight.
examples.zh: 那張木椅承受著他的體重，嘎吱作響。

examples.en: We heard a creak from the attic.
examples.zh: 我們聽到閣樓傳來嘎吱聲。

examples.en: The creak of the gate woke the dog.
examples.zh: 大門的嘎吱聲吵醒了那隻狗。

examples.en: With a loud creak, the window opened.
examples.zh: 窗戶伴隨著一聲響亮的嘎吱聲打開了。

examples.en: The bank is the largest creditor of the company.
examples.zh: 這家銀行是該公司最大的債權人。

examples.en: The creditors sent several letters asking for payment.
examples.zh: 債權人寄了好幾封信要求付款。

examples.en: He owes money to a creditor and must pay it back by June.
examples.zh: 他欠一位債權人錢，必須在六月前還清。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep in her crib.
examples.zh: 寶寶在她的嬰兒床裡睡著了。

examples.en: We bought a new crib for our daughter.
examples.zh: 我們為女兒買了一張新的嬰兒床。

examples.en: Please do not put any toys in the crib.
examples.zh: 請不要把任何玩具放進嬰兒床裡。

examples.en: The crook cheated many old people out of their savings.
examples.zh: 那個騙子騙走了許多老人的積蓄。

examples.en: She held the baby in the crook of her arm.
examples.zh: 她把寶寶抱在臂彎裡。

examples.en: Don't trust that crook; he sold me a fake watch.
examples.zh: 別相信那個騙子，他賣給我一支假錶。

examples.en: The picture on the wall is crooked.
examples.zh: 牆上的畫掛歪了。

examples.en: A crooked path led up the hill.
examples.zh: 一條彎曲的小路通往山上。

examples.en: The crooked salesman cheated customers who trusted his promises.
examples.zh: 那位不老實的業務員欺騙了相信他承諾的顧客。

examples.en: She joined the cross-country team at school.
examples.zh: 她加入了學校的越野隊。

examples.en: We took a cross-country train trip last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天搭火車橫越全國旅行。

examples.en: The cross-country race is held in the park each autumn.
examples.zh: 越野賽跑每年秋天在公園舉行。

examples.en: The children crouched behind the sofa during hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 孩子們玩捉迷藏時蹲在沙發後面。

examples.en: She crouched down to tie her shoelace.
examples.zh: 她蹲下來繫鞋帶。

examples.en: The cat crouched in the grass before it jumped.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在跳起來之前先蹲伏在草叢中。

examples.en: A police cruiser stopped outside the school.
examples.zh: 一輛警用巡邏車停在學校外面。

examples.en: They rented a cruiser to tour the harbor.
examples.zh: 他們租了一艘遊艇遊覽港口。

examples.en: The old cruiser is now a museum.
examples.zh: 那艘老巡洋艦現在是博物館。

examples.en: There were bread crumbs all over the table.
examples.zh: 桌上到處都是麵包屑。

examples.en: She brushed the crumbs off her lap.
examples.zh: 她拍掉腿上的碎屑。

examples.en: There wasn't a crumb of food left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡連一點食物都不剩。

examples.en: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
examples.zh: 那面老牆在雨後開始崩塌。

examples.en: She crumbled the cookie into small pieces.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾捏成小碎片。

examples.en: Their plan crumbled when the money ran out.
examples.zh: 錢用完之後，他們的計畫就瓦解了。

examples.en: He crunched an apple while he watched TV.
examples.zh: 他邊看電視邊嘎吱嘎吱地啃蘋果。

examples.en: The fresh snow crunched under our boots as we walked home.
examples.zh: 我們走路回家時，靴子底下的新雪嘎吱作響。

examples.en: Please don't crunch ice during the meeting.
examples.zh: 開會時請不要嘎吱嘎吱地嚼冰塊。

senses.zh: 嘎吱聲；緊要關頭；脆脆的口感

examples.en: We heard the crunch of gravel under the car.
examples.zh: 我們聽到碎石在車輪下發出的嘎吱聲。

examples.en: When the crunch came, the whole team worked all night.
examples.zh: 緊要關頭來臨時，整個團隊工作了一整夜。

examples.en: This cereal adds a pleasant crunch to my morning yogurt.
examples.zh: 這種麥片為我早餐的優格增添了宜人的酥脆口感。

examples.en: She cut the crust off her sandwich.
examples.zh: 她把三明治的麵包皮切掉。

examples.en: The pie has a thin, golden crust.
examples.zh: 這個派的餅皮薄薄的，呈金黃色。

examples.en: The Earth's crust is made of rock.
examples.zh: 地殼是由岩石構成的。

examples.en: The tank holds ten cubic meters of water.
examples.zh: 這個水槽可以裝十立方公尺的水。

examples.en: The volume of this container is measured in cubic centimeters.
examples.zh: 這個容器的體積以立方公分為單位測量。

examples.en: A cubic box is easy to stack.
examples.zh: 立方體的盒子很容易堆疊。

examples.en: The festival will culminate in a big fireworks show.
examples.zh: 慶典將以盛大的煙火秀達到高潮。

examples.en: Months of training culminated in a gold medal.
examples.zh: 數個月的訓練最終換來一面金牌。

examples.en: The long argument culminated in a handshake.
examples.zh: 這場冗長的爭論最後以握手作結。

examples.en: The teacher explained how a cult controls its members.
examples.zh: 老師說明邪教如何控制成員。

examples.en: The writer was surprised by the cult of celebrity online.
examples.zh: 這位作家對網路上的名人崇拜風潮感到驚訝。

examples.en: Fans created a cult around the young singer.
examples.zh: 粉絲圍繞著這位年輕歌手形成了狂熱崇拜。

examples.en: Cost cutting is common in big companies.
examples.zh: 成本削減在大公司很常見。

examples.en: She kept a cutting from the newspaper about her son.
examples.zh: 她保留了一篇有關兒子的剪報。

examples.en: I planted a cutting from my aunt's rose bush.
examples.zh: 我種下了從阿姨的玫瑰叢剪下的插條。

examples.en: His cutting remark during the meeting hurt his colleague's feelings.
examples.zh: 他在會議上說的尖刻話語傷了同事的感情。

examples.en: The cutting wind made us hurry indoors.
examples.zh: 刺骨的寒風讓我們趕緊進到屋內。

examples.en: The review offered a cutting criticism of the actor's performance.
examples.zh: 影評對這位演員的演出提出尖刻的批評。

examples.en: A can of soup is shaped like a cylinder.
examples.zh: 一罐湯的形狀像圓柱體。

examples.en: The mechanic checked all four cylinders in the car's engine.
examples.zh: 技師檢查了汽車引擎中的四個汽缸。

examples.en: The diver carried a heavy oxygen cylinder.
examples.zh: 潛水員揹著一個沉重的氧氣瓶。

examples.en: Daffodils bloom in early spring along the garden path.
examples.zh: 水仙花在早春沿著花園小徑綻放。

examples.en: She put a bunch of daffodils in a vase.
examples.zh: 她把一束水仙花插進花瓶。

examples.en: My grandmother grows a daffodil in a pot on her balcony.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在陽台的花盆裡種了一株水仙花。

examples.en: The actress was made a dame for her charity work.
examples.zh: 這位女演員因慈善工作被封為女爵士。

examples.en: The school invited a dame who helped start the hospital.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位協助創辦醫院的女爵士。

examples.en: In the play, an old dame tells the children a story.
examples.zh: 劇中一位年長的女士對孩子們說故事。

examples.en: This shampoo helps get rid of dandruff.
examples.zh: 這款洗髮精有助於去除頭皮屑。

examples.en: He brushed the dandruff off his dark jacket.
examples.zh: 他拍掉深色外套上的頭皮屑。

examples.en: Dry air can make dandruff worse in winter.
examples.zh: 乾燥的空氣在冬天會讓頭皮屑更嚴重。

examples.en: The designer wore a daring red dress to the show.
examples.zh: 設計師穿了一件大膽的紅色洋裝出席秀場。

examples.en: It was a daring plan to open a shop in a small town.
examples.zh: 在小鎮開店是個大膽的計畫。

examples.en: The daring boy jumped off the high diving board.
examples.zh: 那個大膽的男孩從高跳台跳了下去。

examples.en: Her daring surprised everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 她的膽量讓班上每個人都感到驚訝。

examples.en: It takes daring to speak in front of a big crowd.
examples.zh: 要在一大群人面前說話需要膽量。

examples.en: He admired the daring of the young pilots.
examples.zh: 他很欽佩那些年輕飛行員的膽識。

examples.en: He threw a dart at the board and hit the center.
examples.zh: 他朝靶投出一支飛鏢，正中紅心。

examples.en: We played darts in the game room during the party.
examples.zh: 派對期間，我們在遊戲室玩飛鏢。

examples.en: She bought a set of darts for her brother.
examples.zh: 她買了一組飛鏢給她哥哥。

examples.en: The squirrel darted up the tree when it heard our footsteps.
examples.zh: 松鼠聽到我們的腳步聲，便飛快地竄上樹。

examples.en: The child darted across the playground to catch up with his friends.
examples.zh: 那個小孩飛快地衝過操場，想追上朋友們。

examples.en: His eyes darted around the room as he searched for his keys.
examples.zh: 他找鑰匙時，目光迅速掃過房間各處。

examples.en: Her day-to-day work includes answering emails and arranging meetings.
examples.zh: 她的日常工作包括回覆電子郵件及安排會議。

examples.en: We are trying to cut our day-to-day costs.
examples.zh: 我們正努力減少日常開銷。

examples.en: The manager handles the day-to-day running of the shop.
examples.zh: 經理負責店裡的日常營運。

examples.en: We left for the mountain at daybreak.
examples.zh: 我們在黎明時出發前往山區。

examples.en: The farmers get up before daybreak to feed their livestock.
examples.zh: 農夫們天亮前就起床餵養家畜。

examples.en: The sky turned pink at daybreak as we packed our tent.
examples.zh: 我們收拾帳篷時，破曉的天空變成粉紅色。

examples.en: Honest dealing is important in business because it builds trust.
examples.zh: 誠信交易對做生意很重要，因為這能建立信任。

examples.en: I have had no dealings with that company.
examples.zh: 我從未和那家公司有過往來。

examples.en: His dealings with customers have always been polite and professional.
examples.zh: 他與顧客往來時一向有禮又專業。

examples.en: Students learn the decimal system in elementary school.
examples.zh: 學生在小學學習十進位制。

examples.en: A decimal point separates the whole number part from the fractional part.
examples.zh: 小數點把整數部分與小數部分分開。

examples.en: Our country adopted a decimal currency long ago.
examples.zh: 我們國家很久以前就採用十進位的貨幣。

examples.en: Write the fraction as a decimal before comparing the two numbers.
examples.zh: 比較這兩個數之前，先把這個分數寫成小數。

examples.en: Round the decimal to two places before recording the measurement.
examples.zh: 記錄測量結果前，先把這個小數四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

examples.en: The number 0.5 is a decimal equal to one half.
examples.zh: 0.5 是等於二分之一的小數。

examples.en: She bought some decorative pillows for the sofa.
examples.zh: 她為沙發買了幾個裝飾用的抱枕。

examples.en: The vase is more decorative than useful.
examples.zh: 這個花瓶裝飾性多於實用性。

examples.en: Decorative lights hung across the street during the town's annual festival.
examples.zh: 小鎮的年度慶典期間，街道上方掛著裝飾用的燈。

examples.en: The king issued a decree to lower taxes.
examples.zh: 國王頒布了降低稅金的法令。

examples.en: The government issued a decree on clean water.
examples.zh: 政府頒布了有關潔淨用水的法令。

examples.en: By decree, the park closes at nine.
examples.zh: 依法令規定，公園九點關閉。

examples.en: The mayor decreed that the street would be closed.
examples.zh: 市長下令封閉這條街。

examples.en: The law decreed that all children must attend school.
examples.zh: 法律規定所有兒童都必須上學。

examples.en: The committee decreed a day of rest.
examples.zh: 委員會宣布放假一天。

examples.en: She is a dedicated teacher who loves her students.
examples.zh: 她是位敬業的老師，很愛她的學生。

examples.en: The library has a dedicated area for children.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一區是兒童專用區。

examples.en: The dedicated volunteers worked all weekend to clean up the beach.
examples.zh: 全心投入的志工整個週末都在清理海灘。

examples.en: From the footprints, we deduced that someone had been here.
examples.zh: 從腳印我們推斷有人來過。

examples.en: She deduced the answer from the clues in the text.
examples.zh: 她從文章中的線索推斷出答案。

examples.en: Can you deduce what he is thinking from his face?
examples.zh: 你能從他的表情推測他在想什麼嗎？

examples.en: A small deduction is made from your salary for insurance.
examples.zh: 你的薪水會被扣除一小筆保險費。

examples.en: Tax deductions can save you a lot of money.
examples.zh: 報稅時的扣除額可以幫你省下很多錢。

examples.en: His deduction turned out to be correct.
examples.zh: 他的推論結果是正確的。

examples.en: The defender blocked the ball before it reached the goal.
examples.zh: 在球到達球門前，後衛把球擋了下來。

examples.en: She is a strong defender of children's rights.
examples.zh: 她是兒童權利的堅定捍衛者。

examples.en: The defender of the title lost in the final round.
examples.zh: 衛冕者在決賽中落敗。

examples.en: The defiant child refused to put on his coat.
examples.zh: 那個反抗的孩子不肯穿上外套。

examples.en: She gave a defiant look and kept walking.
examples.zh: 她投以不服氣的眼神，繼續往前走。

examples.en: The workers were defiant and kept asking for fair pay.
examples.zh: 工人們不肯屈服，持續要求合理的薪資。

examples.en: Vitamin D deficiency can make you feel tired.
examples.zh: 缺乏維生素 D 會讓人覺得疲倦。

examples.en: The report pointed out a deficiency in the school's safety plan.
examples.zh: 報告指出學校的安全計畫有缺失。

examples.en: There is a deficiency of clean water in some villages.
examples.zh: 有些村莊缺乏乾淨的水。

examples.en: The doctor found that her diet was deficient in iron.
examples.zh: 醫生發現她的飲食缺乏鐵質。

examples.en: The deficient wiring in the old building was replaced.
examples.zh: 老建築裡有缺陷的電線被換掉了。

examples.en: The team was deficient in experience but eager to learn.
examples.zh: 這支團隊雖然經驗不足，卻很渴望學習。

examples.en: The friendly debate degenerated into a loud argument.
examples.zh: 這場友善的辯論惡化成大聲爭吵。

examples.en: Without regular exercise, muscles may degenerate and gradually lose their strength.
examples.zh: 缺乏規律運動時，肌肉可能退化，逐漸失去力量。

examples.en: The weather degenerated into a storm by evening.
examples.zh: 天氣到了傍晚惡化成暴風雨。

examples.en: Pollution can degrade the quality of river water.
examples.zh: 汙染會使河水的品質變差。

examples.en: Don't degrade others by making fun of them.
examples.zh: 別嘲笑別人而貶低他們。

examples.en: Some plastic bags take many years to degrade in the natural environment.
examples.zh: 有些塑膠袋在自然環境中需要多年才會分解。

examples.en: He received a notice about his delinquent bill.
examples.zh: 他收到了關於拖欠帳單的通知。

examples.en: The delinquent student was asked to see the counselor.
examples.zh: 行為不良的學生被要求去見輔導老師。

examples.en: Delinquent taxpayers must pay a late fee.
examples.zh: 拖欠稅款的納稅人必須繳納滯納金。

examples.en: The biography describes the famous painter's demise at the age of eighty.
examples.zh: 這本傳記描述了那位著名畫家在八十歲時逝世的情形。

examples.en: The new app led to the demise of paper tickets.
examples.zh: 新的應用程式使紙本票券走向消亡。

examples.en: The company's sudden demise surprised workers who had expected steady growth.
examples.zh: 公司突然倒閉，讓那些原本預期公司會穩定成長的員工感到驚訝。

examples.en: The demonstrators marched peacefully through the city.
examples.zh: 示威者和平地走過市區。

examples.en: A demonstrator showed us how to use the new machine in the store.
examples.zh: 一位示範人員在店裡向我們展示如何使用新機器。

examples.en: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered to ask for cleaner air.
examples.zh: 數百名示威者聚集要求更乾淨的空氣。

examples.en: A red warning light denotes danger near the factory entrance.
examples.zh: 工廠入口附近的紅色警示燈表示危險。

examples.en: In math, the letter x often denotes an unknown number.
examples.zh: 在數學中，字母 x 常用來表示未知數。

examples.en: This symbol denotes a rest area on the map.
examples.zh: 這個符號在地圖上代表休息區。

examples.en: Teachers denounced cheating on exams during the school assembly.
examples.zh: 老師們在學校集會上公開譴責考試作弊。

examples.en: The mayor denounced the dumping of waste in the river.
examples.zh: 市長公開譴責在河裡傾倒廢棄物的行為。

examples.en: Many fans denounced the unfair decision of the referee.
examples.zh: 許多球迷公開譴責裁判不公平的判決。

examples.en: The deployment of new buses will begin next month.
examples.zh: 新公車的部署將在下個月開始。

examples.en: The company announced the deployment of its new software.
examples.zh: 公司公布了新軟體上線的消息。

examples.en: The deployment of more staff helped during the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 假日期間的繁忙時段，增派人員有所幫助。

examples.en: Visitors who break the law may be deported.
examples.zh: 違法的訪客可能被驅逐出境。

examples.en: The man was deported after his visa expired.
examples.zh: 那名男子在簽證到期後被遣送出境。

examples.en: Officials decided to deport him back to his home country.
examples.zh: 官員決定將他遣返回國。

examples.en: She is a descendant of a famous painter.
examples.zh: 她是一位著名畫家的後代。

examples.en: Scientists have found evidence that modern birds are descendants of dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 科學家發現了現代鳥類是恐龍後代的證據。

examples.en: The farm was passed down to the descendants of the founder.
examples.zh: 這座農場傳給了創辦人的子孫。

examples.en: The city designated this area as a park.
examples.zh: 市政府將這一帶指定為公園。

examples.en: Please designate one person to speak for your group.
examples.zh: 請指派一個人代表你們這組發言。

examples.en: Yellow lines designate the parking spaces in the hotel parking lot.
examples.zh: 黃色標線標示出飯店停車場裡的停車位。

senses.zh: 獨棟的；不帶感情的；分離的

examples.en: They live in a detached house with a garden.
examples.zh: 他們住在有花園的獨棟房屋。

examples.en: He sounded detached when he talked about the problem.
examples.zh: 他談到這個問題時聽起來很冷漠。

examples.en: The detached handle was lying on the floor.
examples.zh: 那個已脫離本體的把手擱在地上。

examples.en: Early detection of the disease saves lives.
examples.zh: 及早發現疾病能救人命。

examples.en: The airport uses new equipment for the detection of dangerous items.
examples.zh: 機場使用新設備來偵測危險物品。

examples.en: The cat avoided detection by hiding under the bed.
examples.zh: 那隻貓躲在床下，沒被發現。

examples.en: His health began to deteriorate last winter.
examples.zh: 他的健康從去年冬天開始惡化。

examples.en: The weather will deteriorate this weekend, with heavy rain expected.
examples.zh: 這週末天氣將會變差，預計會下大雨。

examples.en: The old bridge deteriorated because nobody fixed it.
examples.zh: 舊橋因為沒人修理而逐漸損壞。

examples.en: Doctors noticed a deterioration in her condition.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到她的病情惡化了。

examples.en: The deterioration of the road made driving unsafe.
examples.zh: 道路的損壞使開車變得不安全。

examples.en: The deterioration in air quality worries parents.
examples.zh: 空氣品質惡化讓家長們擔心。

examples.en: The government decided to devalue its currency.
examples.zh: 政府決定讓本國貨幣貶值。

examples.en: Don't devalue your own work just because someone criticizes it.
examples.zh: 別只因為有人批評，就貶低自己的成果。

examples.en: Too many copies can devalue a famous painting.
examples.zh: 太多複製品可能讓名畫貶值。

examples.en: The storm threatened to devastate the small fishing village.
examples.zh: 這場風暴可能會摧毀這個小漁村。

examples.en: The news of the closing will devastate our teachers.
examples.zh: 學校關閉的消息會讓我們的老師們悲痛萬分。

examples.en: A single mistake can devastate a young company.
examples.zh: 一個錯誤就可能毀掉一家新創公司。

senses.zh: 毀滅性的；令人震驚悲痛的

examples.en: The flood had a devastating effect on local farms.
examples.zh: 這場洪水對當地農場造成了毀滅性的影響。

examples.en: It was devastating news for the whole family.
examples.zh: 這對全家人來說是令人悲痛的消息。

examples.en: The team suffered a devastating loss in the final game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊在決賽中遭遇了慘痛的敗北。

examples.en: Taiwan is a highly developed country in Asia.
examples.zh: 台灣是亞洲高度發達的國家。

examples.en: Many developed nations are trying to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 許多已開發國家正努力減少塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: The child has a sense of humor that is already well developed.
examples.zh: 這個孩子的幽默感已經發展得很好。

senses.zh: 程式開發人員；房地產開發商

examples.en: My brother works as a software developer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在台北擔任軟體開發人員。

examples.en: The developer plans to build a new mall near the station.
examples.zh: 開發商計畫在車站附近蓋一座新的購物中心。

examples.en: The game developer answered questions from fans online.
examples.zh: 這位遊戲開發者在線上回答了粉絲的提問。

examples.en: Many developing countries need clean water systems.
examples.zh: 許多開發中國家需要供應乾淨用水的系統。

examples.en: Many students in developing regions still lack internet access.
examples.zh: 許多發展中地區的學生仍然無法上網。

examples.en: She is interested in the developing economies of Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 她對東南亞的開發中經濟體很感興趣。

examples.en: Please do not deviate from the plan we agreed on.
examples.zh: 請不要偏離我們同意的計畫。

examples.en: The bus had to deviate from its route because of the parade.
examples.zh: 因為遊行，公車必須改道行駛。

examples.en: His results deviate slightly from those of the other group.
examples.zh: 他的結果與另一組的稍有出入。

examples.en: The smell of coffee began to diffuse through the office.
examples.zh: 咖啡的香味開始在辦公室裡擴散開來。

examples.en: Scientists study how heat can diffuse through metal.
examples.zh: 科學家研究熱如何在金屬中傳導擴散。

examples.en: The curtains diffuse the bright afternoon sunlight.
examples.zh: 窗簾使明亮的午後陽光變得柔和。

senses.zh: 分布廣泛的；漫射的；冗長鬆散的

examples.en: The room was filled with soft, diffuse light.
examples.zh: 房間裡充滿柔和的漫射光線。

examples.en: Her diffuse writing style makes the report hard to follow.
examples.zh: 她冗長鬆散的寫作風格讓這份報告很難看懂。

examples.en: The pain was diffuse and hard to locate exactly.
examples.zh: 這種疼痛範圍很廣，很難確定確切位置。

examples.en: You should dilute the juice with some water.
examples.zh: 你應該用一些水把果汁稀釋。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to dilute the acid carefully.
examples.zh: 老師要我們小心地稀釋這種酸液。

examples.en: Too many changes may dilute the meaning of the story.
examples.zh: 太多改動可能會沖淡故事的意涵。

examples.en: Use a dilute solution to clean the window.
examples.zh: 請用稀釋過的溶液擦窗戶。

examples.en: The medicine is sold as a dilute liquid.
examples.zh: 這種藥是以稀釋過的液體販售。

examples.en: Use dilute soapy water to wash the pots before planting seeds.
examples.zh: 播種前，用低濃度肥皂水清洗花盆。

examples.en: They had a disagreement about where to go on vacation.
examples.zh: 他們對於度假要去哪裡意見不合。

examples.en: The disagreement between the two teams delayed the project.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊之間的分歧延誤了專案。

examples.en: There is still some disagreement over the price.
examples.zh: 價格方面仍有一些分歧。

examples.en: It is hard to discern the road in thick fog.
examples.zh: 在濃霧中很難辨別道路。

examples.en: Can you discern any difference between these two photos?
examples.zh: 你看得出這兩張照片有任何差別嗎？

examples.en: Teachers can often discern which students need extra help.
examples.zh: 老師常常能看出哪些學生需要額外協助。

examples.en: The rumor was meant to discredit the new manager.
examples.zh: 這則謠言是要損害新經理的名譽。

examples.en: The report tried to discredit the scientist's findings.
examples.zh: 這份報告試圖讓人質疑那位科學家的研究結果。

examples.en: Cheating on the test will discredit your whole class.
examples.zh: 考試作弊會損害全班的名譽。

examples.en: The accountant found a discrepancy in the monthly report.
examples.zh: 會計師在月報表中發現了不一致的地方。

examples.en: There is a large discrepancy between the two stories.
examples.zh: 這兩種說法之間有很大的出入。

examples.en: Please explain the discrepancy in these numbers.
examples.zh: 請說明這些數字的差異。

examples.en: The book is divided into five discrete sections.
examples.zh: 這本書分成五個各自獨立的部分。

examples.en: Each student will receive a discrete score for every task.
examples.zh: 每位學生每項作業都會得到一個獨立的分數。

examples.en: Sound is made up of discrete units in this model.
examples.zh: 在這個模型中，聲音是由不連續的單位組成的。

senses.zh: 判斷力；自行決定權；謹慎

examples.en: The teacher has the discretion to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 老師有權決定是否延後截止日期。

examples.en: Please use your discretion when sharing this email.
examples.zh: 分享這封電子郵件時，請謹慎判斷。

examples.en: Parents are advised to use discretion when choosing movies for children.
examples.zh: 建議家長為孩子選擇電影時要審慎斟酌。

senses.zh: 可恥的；糟糕得令人無法接受的

examples.en: It was disgraceful to cheat on the final exam.
examples.zh: 在期末考作弊是很可恥的。

examples.en: The restaurant's dirty kitchen was disgraceful and failed the health inspection.
examples.zh: 那家餐廳的廚房髒得令人無法接受，也未通過衛生檢查。

examples.en: Her disgraceful behavior at the party surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她在派對上的丟臉行為讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: The old paper began to disintegrate in my hands.
examples.zh: 那張舊紙在我手中開始碎裂。

examples.en: The wet cardboard box started to disintegrate.
examples.zh: 濕掉的紙箱開始散開。

examples.en: The band began to disintegrate after the lead singer left.
examples.zh: 主唱離開後，這個樂團開始瓦解。

examples.en: The workers will dismantle the stage after the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會結束後，工人會拆除舞台。

examples.en: He learned how to dismantle a bicycle and put it back together.
examples.zh: 他學會了如何拆開腳踏車再組裝回去。

examples.en: The company plans to dismantle its outdated approval system next year.
examples.zh: 公司計畫明年廢除過時的審核制度。

examples.en: His dismissal from the company came as a shock.
examples.zh: 他被公司解僱讓人很震驚。

examples.en: The judge ordered the dismissal of the case.
examples.zh: 法官裁定駁回該案件。

examples.en: The class waited quietly for the teacher's dismissal.
examples.zh: 全班安靜地等老師宣布下課。

examples.en: The company will dispatch a technician to your home.
examples.zh: 公司會派一名技術人員到府服務。

examples.en: Please dispatch the package before noon so it can arrive tomorrow.
examples.zh: 請在中午前寄出包裹，以便明天送達。

examples.en: The manager dispatched two drivers to the airport.
examples.zh: 經理派了兩名司機前往機場。

examples.en: The crowd began to disperse after the concert ended.
examples.zh: 演唱會結束後，人群開始散去。

examples.en: The wind helped disperse the smoke from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 風幫忙吹散了廚房的煙。

examples.en: Seeds disperse in many different ways, including by wind and water.
examples.zh: 種子以許多不同的方式散播，包括藉由風和水。

examples.en: Robots may displace workers in some factories.
examples.zh: 在某些工廠裡，機器人可能會取代工人。

examples.en: The flood displaced thousands of families from their homes.
examples.zh: 這場洪水迫使數千個家庭離開家園。

examples.en: The heavy box displaced the water in the tank.
examples.zh: 那個重箱子排開了水槽裡的水。

examples.en: The loud music may displease our neighbors.
examples.zh: 大聲的音樂可能會惹惱我們的鄰居。

examples.en: He did not want to displease his parents.
examples.zh: 他不想讓父母不高興。

examples.en: Her late reply seemed to displease the manager.
examples.zh: 她太晚回覆似乎讓經理不太高興。

examples.en: She has a cheerful disposition and gets along with everyone.
examples.zh: 她性情開朗，和每個人都處得來。

examples.en: My cat has a calm disposition, even around unfamiliar visitors.
examples.zh: 我的貓性情平和，即使面對陌生訪客也是如此。

examples.en: There is a disposition to buy online during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間人們傾向在網路上購物。

examples.en: Please do not disregard the safety rules.
examples.zh: 請不要漠視安全規定。

examples.en: He chose to disregard his friend's advice.
examples.zh: 他選擇不理會朋友的建議。

examples.en: Drivers who disregard traffic lights put everyone in danger.
examples.zh: 無視紅綠燈的駕駛會讓所有人陷入危險。

examples.en: His disregard for the rules upset the teacher.
examples.zh: 他對規定的漠視讓老師很不高興。

examples.en: She walked into the street with total disregard for the traffic.
examples.zh: 她完全不顧來往車輛就走進了馬路。

examples.en: The company showed disregard for its customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司對顧客毫不在乎。

examples.en: The dissident was invited to speak at the university.
examples.zh: 這位異議人士受邀到大學演講。

examples.en: Several dissidents left the country to write freely.
examples.zh: 幾位異議人士離開國家以便自由寫作。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a famous dissident.
examples.zh: 這本書講述一位著名異議人士的故事。

examples.en: The morning fog will gradually dissipate as the air gets warmer.
examples.zh: 隨著空氣變暖，晨霧會逐漸消散。

examples.en: His anger began to dissipate after a short walk.
examples.zh: 散步一會兒之後，他的怒氣開始消散。

examples.en: Heat can dissipate quickly through a thin metal plate.
examples.zh: 熱能會很快地經由薄金屬板散失。

examples.en: We tried to dissuade him from quitting school.
examples.zh: 我們試著勸他不要輟學。

examples.en: Her parents could not dissuade her from traveling alone.
examples.zh: 她的父母無法勸阻她獨自旅行。

examples.en: The high price did not dissuade customers from buying it.
examples.zh: 高昂的價格並沒有讓顧客打消購買的念頭。

examples.en: Workers distill the liquid to make pure water.
examples.zh: 工人將液體蒸餾以製成純水。

examples.en: They distill the plant oil in a large metal tank.
examples.zh: 他們在大型金屬槽裡蒸餾植物油。

examples.en: The teacher helped us distill the main idea from the long article.
examples.zh: 老師幫助我們從這篇長文中提煉出主旨。

examples.en: The old mirror seems to distort your face.
examples.zh: 那面舊鏡子似乎會讓你的臉變形。

examples.en: The news report may distort the facts.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導可能會扭曲事實。

examples.en: High temperatures can distort a plastic ruler left in direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 高溫可能使放在陽光直射處的塑膠尺變形。

examples.en: The teacher distributed the worksheets to every student.
examples.zh: 老師把學習單發給每位學生。

examples.en: The charity distributed free meals to the elderly.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構把免費餐點發送給長者。

examples.en: The company distributed its new phone in several countries.
examples.zh: 這家公司在多個國家分銷自家的新款手機。

examples.en: The distributor sends fresh fruit to local stores.
examples.zh: 這家經銷商把新鮮水果送到當地商店。

examples.en: Our company is the main distributor of the brand in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我們公司是該品牌在台灣的主要經銷商。

examples.en: Please contact the distributor if the product is damaged.
examples.zh: 如果商品受損，請聯絡經銷商。

examples.en: She felt disturbed by the strange noise outside.
examples.zh: 她被外面奇怪的聲音弄得很不安。

examples.en: The disturbed sleep left him tired all day.
examples.zh: 睡眠一直被打擾讓他整天都很累。

examples.en: The children were disturbed by the scary movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們被那部恐怖電影嚇得心神不寧。

examples.en: The documentary contains some disturbing images of the polluted river.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片含有一些令人不安的河川汙染畫面。

examples.en: It is disturbing to see so much trash on the beach.
examples.zh: 看到沙灘上有這麼多垃圾讓人感到不安。

examples.en: The doctor noticed a disturbing change in his test results.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到他的檢查結果有令人擔憂的變化。

senses.zh: 注定失敗的；劫數難逃的

examples.en: The plan was doomed from the start.
examples.zh: 這個計畫從一開始就注定失敗。

examples.en: The doomed ship sank before help arrived.
examples.zh: 那艘注定難逃一劫的船在救援抵達前就沉了。

examples.en: He felt doomed to fail the exam without any study time.
examples.zh: 沒有時間念書，他覺得這次考試註定會考砸。

examples.en: A package was left on our doorstep this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有個包裹被放在我們家門口。

examples.en: The cat sat on the doorstep and waited for dinner.
examples.zh: 貓坐在門階上等著吃晚餐。

examples.en: The new supermarket is right on our doorstep.
examples.zh: 新的超市就在我們家門口。

examples.en: The doctor explained the correct dosage of the medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了這種藥的正確劑量。

examples.en: Do not exceed the recommended dosage printed on the medicine label.
examples.zh: 請勿超過藥品標籤上印載的建議劑量。

examples.en: A child needs a smaller dosage than an adult.
examples.zh: 小孩需要的劑量比大人少。

examples.en: She will doubtless pass the test with her hard work.
examples.zh: 憑她的努力，她無疑會通過考試。

examples.en: The new teacher is doubtless a very kind person.
examples.zh: 這位新老師無疑是個非常親切的人。

examples.en: This is doubtless the best cake I have ever eaten.
examples.zh: 這無疑是我吃過最好吃的蛋糕。

examples.en: The city is improving its drainage to prevent floods.
examples.zh: 市政府正在改善排水系統以防止淹水。

examples.en: Poor drainage left puddles on the school field.
examples.zh: 排水不良使學校操場上出現多處積水。

examples.en: Good drainage is important for healthy plants.
examples.zh: 良好的排水對植物的健康很重要。

examples.en: She likes to drape a scarf over her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她喜歡把圍巾披在肩上。

examples.en: They drape a flag over the table every year.
examples.zh: 他們每年都會在桌上鋪一面旗子。

examples.en: Please drape the cloth over the chair.
examples.zh: 請把布披在椅子上。

examples.en: The main drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機的主要缺點是電池續航力短。

examples.en: Living far from school has one big drawback.
examples.zh: 住得離學校很遠有一個很大的缺點。

examples.en: Every plan has some drawbacks, so we should compare the options carefully.
examples.zh: 每個計畫都有一些缺點，所以我們應仔細比較各個選項。

examples.en: It was a dreary, rainy Monday morning.
examples.zh: 那是個陰沉多雨的星期一早晨。

examples.en: The old office looked dreary with its gray walls.
examples.zh: 那間有灰色牆面的舊辦公室看起來很沉悶。

examples.en: Copying the numbers by hand was dreary work for the students.
examples.zh: 對學生們來說，手抄這些數字是項乏味的工作。

examples.en: A light drizzle fell on the city all afternoon.
examples.zh: 一整個下午，城裡都下著細雨。

examples.en: We walked to school in the drizzle.
examples.zh: 我們在毛毛雨中走路去上學。

examples.en: The drizzle stopped just before the game began.
examples.zh: 毛毛雨在比賽開始前停了。

examples.en: It began to drizzle as we left the museum.
examples.zh: 我們離開博物館時開始下起毛毛雨。

examples.en: Drizzle some honey on the pancakes before you serve them.
examples.zh: 上桌前，先在鬆餅上淋一點蜂蜜。

examples.en: The chef will drizzle oil over the salad.
examples.zh: 主廚會在沙拉上淋油。

examples.en: Fans dubbed the young player the king of speed.
examples.zh: 球迷替這位年輕球員取了「速度之王」的稱號。

examples.en: The movie was dubbed into Mandarin for the local audience.
examples.zh: 這部電影被配上國語給本地觀眾看。

examples.en: The press dubbed the storm the worst in ten years.
examples.zh: 媒體把這場風暴稱為十年來最嚴重的一場。

examples.en: Please duplicate this file before you edit it.
examples.zh: 編輯之前請先複製這個檔案。

examples.en: The machine can duplicate a key in one minute.
examples.zh: 這台機器一分鐘就能複製一把鑰匙。

examples.en: It is hard to duplicate her success.
examples.zh: 她的成功很難複製。

examples.en: Keep a duplicate of the form for your records.
examples.zh: 請保留一份表格副本作紀錄。

examples.en: This painting is a duplicate of the original.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是原作的複製品。

examples.en: I made a duplicate of my house key.
examples.zh: 我複製了一把家裡的鑰匙。

examples.en: We found a duplicate record in the list.
examples.zh: 我們在名單中發現了重複的紀錄。

examples.en: Please delete the duplicate photos before sharing the album with your family.
examples.zh: 與家人分享相簿前，請先刪除重複的照片。

examples.en: I received a duplicate bill by mistake.
examples.zh: 我誤收到一張重複的帳單。

examples.en: The dying plant needs more water and sunlight.
examples.zh: 這株快枯死的植物需要更多水和陽光。

examples.en: Many people want to save the dying art of paper cutting.
examples.zh: 許多人想挽救瀕臨失傳的剪紙藝術。

examples.en: The farmer carried water to his dying crops.
examples.zh: 農夫把水搬去給快枯死的農作物。

senses.zh: 炸藥；極具威力的人事物

examples.en: Workers used dynamite to clear the rocks from the road.
examples.zh: 工人用炸藥清除路上的岩石。

examples.en: The new song is pure dynamite on the dance floor.
examples.zh: 這首新歌在舞池裡極具魅力。

examples.en: Construction teams must handle dynamite with great care.
examples.zh: 施工人員處理炸藥時必須非常小心。

examples.en: I wear earphones when I study on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上念書時會戴耳機。

examples.en: These earphones are small enough to fit in my pocket.
examples.zh: 這副耳機小到可以放進我的口袋。

examples.en: Please use earphones in the library so you do not disturb others.
examples.zh: 在圖書館請使用耳機，以免打擾別人。

examples.en: The tide begins to ebb in the late afternoon.
examples.zh: 潮水在傍晚時開始退去。

examples.en: His excitement began to ebb as the game went on.
examples.zh: 隨著比賽進行，他的興奮感漸漸消退。

examples.en: Public interest in the show started to ebb.
examples.zh: 大眾對這個節目的興趣開始減退。

examples.en: The fans screamed in ecstasy when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手一出現，粉絲們欣喜若狂地尖叫。

examples.en: She jumped in ecstasy after hearing the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息後，她欣喜若狂地跳了起來。

examples.en: The children were in ecstasy at the sight of the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到雪便歡欣雀躍。

examples.en: She was ecstatic about winning the first prize.
examples.zh: 她對贏得首獎感到欣喜若狂。

examples.en: The students were ecstatic when the trip was confirmed.
examples.zh: 旅行確定後，學生們興奮極了。

examples.en: My parents were ecstatic to see me graduate.
examples.zh: 我的父母看到我畢業，欣喜若狂。

examples.en: She wore a white blouse edged with delicate lace.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件鑲著細緻蕾絲邊的白襯衫。

examples.en: The tablecloth is edged in gold thread and looks quite elegant.
examples.zh: 這條桌巾以金線鑲邊，看起來相當優雅。

examples.en: Keep edged tools such as scissors out of the reach of small children.
examples.zh: 剪刀之類有鋒刃的工具要放在幼兒拿不到的地方。

senses.zh: 慢慢挪動；以些微差距領先

examples.en: The car edged forward slowly through the crowded market street.
examples.zh: 車子在擁擠的市場街道上緩緩前進。

examples.en: Our team edged ahead of the other class in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 我們這隊在最後幾分鐘以些微差距超前另一個班。

examples.en: He edged closer to the door so he could leave quietly.
examples.zh: 他悄悄往門邊挪近，好安靜地離開。

examples.en: She is a highly educated woman who speaks four languages.
examples.zh: 她是一位受過高等教育的女性，會說四種語言。

examples.en: Parents want their children to grow up to be educated citizens.
examples.zh: 父母希望孩子長大成為受過教育的公民。

examples.en: The doctor made an educated guess about the cause of the cough.
examples.zh: 醫生對咳嗽的原因做出有根據的推測。

examples.en: We ate grilled eel over rice for dinner at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐在夜市吃了烤鰻魚飯。

examples.en: The eel slipped out of my hands and fell back into the water.
examples.zh: 那條鰻魚從我手中滑出，掉回水裡。

examples.en: An eel looks like a snake, but it is actually a fish.
examples.zh: 鰻魚看起來像蛇，但牠其實是魚。

examples.en: Press this button to eject the disc from the player.
examples.zh: 按這個按鈕就能把光碟從播放機彈出來。

examples.en: The security guard had to eject the noisy fans from the stadium.
examples.zh: 保全人員必須把吵鬧的球迷請出體育場。

examples.en: The old machine began to eject smoke into the room.
examples.zh: 那台老機器開始往房間裡噴出煙。

examples.en: A few minutes elapsed before anyone answered the phone.
examples.zh: 幾分鐘過去了才有人接電話。

examples.en: Please do not open the lid until ten minutes have elapsed.
examples.zh: 在十分鐘過去之前，請不要打開蓋子。

examples.en: Several years elapsed before we met again at the reunion.
examples.zh: 好幾年過去後，我們才在同學會上再次見面。

examples.en: The electoral system in this country has changed several times.
examples.zh: 這個國家的選舉制度已經改變過好幾次。

examples.en: Voters must check the electoral list posted at the town hall.
examples.zh: 選民必須查看張貼在市政廳的選舉人名冊。

examples.en: Young people play a growing role in the electoral process.
examples.zh: 年輕人在選舉過程中扮演越來越重要的角色。

examples.en: The electorate will go to the polls on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 全體選民將在週六早上前往投票。

examples.en: The mayor promised to listen more closely to the electorate.
examples.zh: 市長承諾會更用心傾聽選民的心聲。

examples.en: A large part of the electorate is under the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 選民中有很大一部分年齡在三十歲以下。

examples.en: An electron carries a negative electric charge.
examples.zh: 電子帶有負電荷。

examples.en: In science class we learned how an electron moves around the nucleus.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們學到電子如何繞著原子核運行。

examples.en: Each atom has electrons arranged in layers around its center.
examples.zh: 每個原子的電子都分層排列在中心周圍。

senses.zh: 高架的；偏高的；位置較高的

examples.en: The train runs on an elevated track above the busy road.
examples.zh: 這班列車行駛在繁忙道路上方的高架軌道上。

examples.en: The doctor found that his blood pressure was slightly elevated.
examples.zh: 醫生發現他的血壓略微偏高。

examples.en: The elevated position of the café gives guests a great view.
examples.zh: 那間咖啡廳位置較高，讓客人有絕佳的視野。

examples.en: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters.
examples.zh: 這座村莊位於海拔兩千公尺處。

examples.en: The elevation of the hiking trail rises quickly after the first kilometer.
examples.zh: 登山步道的高度在第一公里之後迅速上升。

examples.en: Her elevation to team captain surprised no one in the club.
examples.zh: 她升任隊長，社團裡沒有人感到意外。

examples.en: The teacher asked questions to elicit answers from the shy students.
examples.zh: 老師提問，好讓害羞的學生說出答案。

examples.en: The funny video elicited laughter from the whole audience.
examples.zh: 那支搞笑影片引起全場觀眾大笑。

examples.en: The survey aims to elicit honest opinions about school lunches.
examples.zh: 這項問卷旨在引出大家對學校午餐的真實意見。

examples.en: Please check your eligibility before you apply for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 申請獎學金之前，請先確認你是否具備資格。

examples.en: Proof of age is required to confirm eligibility for the discount.
examples.zh: 需出示年齡證明以確認是否符合折扣資格。

examples.en: His eligibility to play ended when his grades dropped.
examples.zh: 他的成績下滑後，就失去了比賽資格。

examples.en: Only a small elite can afford to live in this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 只有少數菁英負擔得起住在這個社區。

examples.en: The business elite of the city attended the charity dinner.
examples.zh: 這座城市的商界菁英出席了慈善晚宴。

examples.en: She hopes to join the elite of professional swimmers someday.
examples.zh: 她希望有一天能躋身頂尖游泳選手之列。

examples.en: He trained hard to join the elite swim team.
examples.zh: 他努力訓練，想加入菁英游泳隊。

examples.en: Elite athletes often practice for six hours a day.
examples.zh: 頂尖運動員往往每天練習六個小時。

examples.en: The company offers an elite service to its best customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司為最好的客戶提供頂級服務。

examples.en: The speaker moved the audience with her eloquence.
examples.zh: 講者以她的口才打動了觀眾。

examples.en: He spoke with great eloquence at the school farewell ceremony.
examples.zh: 他在學校的歡送典禮上口才出眾，說得非常動人。

examples.en: Her eloquence helped her win the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 她的口才幫助她贏得了英語演講比賽。

examples.en: The government placed an embargo on oil from the region.
examples.zh: 政府對該地區的石油實施禁運。

examples.en: The embargo made it hard for shops to buy foreign goods.
examples.zh: 禁運讓商店很難進口外國商品。

examples.en: Leaders agreed to lift the embargo after months of talks.
examples.zh: 領袖們經過數月談判後同意解除禁運。

examples.en: Passengers began to embark on the ferry at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 乘客九點開始登上渡輪。

examples.en: She will embark on a new career next month.
examples.zh: 她下個月將展開新的職涯。

examples.en: We embark on a project to clean up the beach.
examples.zh: 我們著手進行一項淨灘專案。

examples.en: She turned red with embarrassment when she forgot her lines.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時尷尬得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: His loud phone call on the bus was a real embarrassment to his sister.
examples.zh: 他在公車上大聲講電話，讓他妹妹覺得很丟臉。

examples.en: To avoid embarrassment, check your speech again before the meeting.
examples.zh: 為了避免尷尬，開會前請再檢查一次你的發言稿。

examples.en: Workers embed steel bars in the concrete to make it stronger.
examples.zh: 工人把鋼筋嵌入混凝土中，使它更堅固。

examples.en: You can embed a video in your web page with a short piece of code.
examples.zh: 你可以用一小段程式碼，將影片嵌入自己的網頁。

examples.en: The doctor said a small piece of glass was embedded in his foot.
examples.zh: 醫生說他的腳裡嵌著一小塊玻璃。

examples.en: This statue is meant to embody the spirit of the city.
examples.zh: 這座雕像是為了體現這座城市的精神。

examples.en: Our new teacher embodies patience and kindness.
examples.zh: 我們的新老師體現了耐心與善良。

examples.en: The song embodies the hopes of a whole generation.
examples.zh: 這首歌體現了整個世代的希望。

examples.en: A chicken embryo grows inside the egg for about three weeks.
examples.zh: 雞的胚胎在蛋裡大約發育三週。

examples.en: Scientists study the embryo to learn how animals develop.
examples.zh: 科學家研究胚胎，以了解動物如何發育。

examples.en: In the early stage, the human embryo is smaller than a grain of rice.
examples.zh: 人類胚胎在早期比一粒米還小。

examples.en: The emergence of smartphones changed the way we take photos.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

examples.en: The emergence of online shopping hurt many small stores.
examples.zh: 網路購物的興起打擊了許多小商店。

examples.en: We watched the emergence of a moth from its cocoon.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻蛾從繭裡羽化而出。

examples.en: The old refrigerator began to emit a strange noise.
examples.zh: 那台舊冰箱開始發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: Cars emit gases that pollute the air around busy roads.
examples.zh: 汽車排放的氣體會汙染繁忙道路周遭的空氣。

examples.en: The lamp emits a soft yellow light in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 這盞燈在臥室裡散發柔和的黃光。

examples.en: She gave an emphatic no when we asked if she wanted dessert.
examples.zh: 當我們問她要不要甜點時，她斷然說不要。

examples.en: The coach was emphatic about the need to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 教練堅定地表示，必須準時到達。

examples.en: Our team won an emphatic victory in the final game.
examples.zh: 我們隊在決賽中取得壓倒性的勝利。

senses.zh: 以觀察或實驗為依據的

examples.en: Scientists need empirical evidence to support their ideas.
examples.zh: 科學家需要實證證據來支持他們的想法。

examples.en: The study is based on empirical data collected over five years.
examples.zh: 這項研究是根據五年來蒐集的實證資料。

examples.en: The students ran an empirical test to see which plant grows faster.
examples.zh: 學生們進行了一項實證測試，看哪種植物長得比較快。

examples.en: The city plans to enact a new law on plastic bags.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫制定一項關於塑膠袋的新法規。

examples.en: The school board enacted a rule against using phones in class.
examples.zh: 校董會通過了禁止在課堂上使用手機的規定。

examples.en: Students will enact a scene from the story in class.
examples.zh: 學生們將在課堂上演出故事中的一幕。

examples.en: The zoo built a larger enclosure for the pandas.
examples.zh: 動物園為貓熊建了一個更大的圍場。

examples.en: The enclosure with this letter shows the course schedule.
examples.zh: 這封信的附件列出了課程時間表。

examples.en: A tall fence forms an enclosure around the playground.
examples.zh: 一道高圍籬在遊樂場四周圍出一塊場地。

senses.zh: 無盡的；無邊無際的；沒完沒了的

examples.en: The desert seemed endless under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 在烈日下，沙漠看起來無邊無際。

examples.en: We listened to the teacher's endless stories about her trip.
examples.zh: 我們聽老師沒完沒了地講她的旅行故事。

examples.en: The park offers endless fun for children of all ages.
examples.zh: 這座公園為各年齡的孩子提供無盡的樂趣。

examples.en: A rich businessman endowed the school with a new library.
examples.zh: 一位富商捐贈了一座新圖書館給學校。

examples.en: Nature has endowed her with a beautiful singing voice.
examples.zh: 大自然賦予她一副美妙的歌喉。

examples.en: The family plans to endow a scholarship for students from low-income homes.
examples.zh: 這個家庭打算捐資設立獎學金，資助來自低收入家庭的學生。

examples.en: A cup of tea can energize you on a sleepy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一杯茶可以讓你在昏昏欲睡的下午恢復活力。

examples.en: The coach's speech energized the whole team before the game.
examples.zh: 教練的談話讓全隊在比賽前振奮起來。

examples.en: Morning exercise helps energize students for a busy school day.
examples.zh: 晨間運動有助於讓學生充滿活力，迎接忙碌的上學日。

examples.en: Strict enforcement of the rules keeps the swimming pool safe.
examples.zh: 嚴格執行規定能維持游泳池的安全。

examples.en: Law enforcement officers directed traffic outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 執法人員在體育場外指揮交通。

examples.en: Enforcement of the new parking rule begins next Monday.
examples.zh: 新的停車規定將從下週一開始執行。

senses.zh: 已訂婚的；忙線的；忙於……的

examples.en: My cousin is engaged to a teacher she met in college.
examples.zh: 我表姊與她大學時認識的老師訂婚了。

examples.en: His line was engaged, so I tried again after lunch.
examples.zh: 他的電話忙線中，所以我午餐後又打了一次。

examples.en: He is engaged in a study of local birds.
examples.zh: 他正忙於一項本地鳥類的研究。

examples.en: Their engagement was announced at the family dinner.
examples.zh: 他們的訂婚消息在家庭聚餐上宣布。

examples.en: I have a prior engagement on Friday evening, so I cannot come.
examples.zh: 我週五晚上已有約，所以沒辦法來。

examples.en: Teachers try to increase student engagement in class discussions.
examples.zh: 老師們努力提高學生參與課堂討論的程度。

examples.en: A long silence ensued after the teacher asked the question.
examples.zh: 老師提出問題後，隨之而來的是一陣長長的沉默。

examples.en: If you ignore the warning, serious problems may ensue.
examples.zh: 如果你忽視警告，可能會隨之出現嚴重的問題。

examples.en: An argument ensued when both people wanted the last seat.
examples.zh: 兩個人都想要最後一個座位，爭執隨之發生。

examples.en: The job will entail some travel to other cities.
examples.zh: 這份工作會涉及到其他城市出差。

examples.en: Buying a house entails a lot of paperwork.
examples.zh: 買房子需要處理大量文件。

examples.en: Changing schools would entail moving to another town.
examples.zh: 轉學意味著要搬到另一個城鎮。

examples.en: My uncle is a camera enthusiast who owns twelve lenses.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是相機愛好者，擁有十二顆鏡頭。

examples.en: Soccer enthusiasts filled the café to watch the match.
examples.zh: 足球愛好者擠滿咖啡廳看比賽。

examples.en: The club welcomes any enthusiast of old movies.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎任何老電影的愛好者。

examples.en: The environmentalist asked students to stop using plastic straws.
examples.zh: 那位環保人士請同學們不要再使用塑膠吸管。

examples.en: Many environmentalists support the plan to plant more trees in the city.
examples.zh: 許多環保人士支持在市區多種樹的計畫。

examples.en: My aunt, an environmentalist, always brings her own shopping bag.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是環保人士，總是自備購物袋。

examples.en: We envisage a bright future for our small business.
examples.zh: 我們預想我們的小事業會有光明的未來。

examples.en: Nobody envisaged that the meeting would take four hours.
examples.zh: 沒有人想到這場會議會開四個小時。

examples.en: The architect envisaged a park in the middle of the town.
examples.zh: 建築師設想在城鎮中心蓋一座公園。

examples.en: The government sent an envoy to the international conference.
examples.zh: 政府派了一位特使出席國際會議。

examples.en: The envoy thanked the host country for its warm welcome.
examples.zh: 特使感謝東道國的熱情接待。

examples.en: As a trade envoy, she travels abroad to meet business partners.
examples.zh: 身為貿易特使，她常出國拜訪商業夥伴。

examples.en: Saliva contains an enzyme that helps break down food.
examples.zh: 唾液含有一種酵素，能幫助分解食物。

examples.en: Some soaps contain an enzyme that removes food stains.
examples.zh: 有些肥皂含有可去除食物汙漬的酵素。

examples.en: The enzyme in pineapple can make your tongue feel a little sore.
examples.zh: 鳳梨裡的酵素會讓你的舌頭有點刺痛。

examples.en: The film tells an epic story of a family crossing the ocean.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個家庭橫渡大洋的史詩般故事。

examples.en: They took an epic journey across the country by train.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車展開一趟橫越全國的壯闊旅程。

examples.en: Our class made an epic effort to clean the whole school.
examples.zh: 我們班為了打掃整間學校付出了極大的努力。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to read an epic written long ago.
examples.zh: 老師要我們讀一部很久以前寫成的史詩。

examples.en: Homer wrote a famous epic about a long sea voyage.
examples.zh: 荷馬寫了一部關於漫長海上航行的著名史詩。

examples.en: The class performed a short scene from the epic.
examples.zh: 全班演出了這部史詩中的一小段場景。

examples.en: The invention of the printing press began a new epoch.
examples.zh: 印刷機的發明開創了一個新時代。

examples.en: This epoch of history is full of great changes.
examples.zh: 歷史上的這個時代充滿了重大的變化。

examples.en: Scientists call our current epoch the Holocene.
examples.zh: 科學家把我們現在所處的時代稱為全新世。

examples.en: Her high EQ helps her get along with all her classmates.
examples.zh: 她的情緒智商很高，有助於她和所有同學相處融洽。

examples.en: Good teachers need a high EQ as well as subject knowledge.
examples.zh: 好老師除了學科知識，也需要很高的情緒智商。

examples.en: The company offers a workshop to help managers improve their EQ.
examples.zh: 公司提供工作坊，協助主管提升情緒智商。

examples.en: The equator divides the earth into two halves.
examples.zh: 赤道把地球分成兩半。

examples.en: It is hot all year in countries close to the equator.
examples.zh: 靠近赤道的國家全年都很炎熱。

examples.en: Our ship crossed the equator on the fifth day.
examples.zh: 我們的船在第五天越過赤道。

examples.en: The gymnast lost her equilibrium and stepped off the beam.
examples.zh: 體操選手失去平衡，踩出了平衡木。

examples.en: The market reaches equilibrium when the quantity supplied equals the quantity demanded.
examples.zh: 當供給量等於需求量時，市場就達到均衡。

examples.en: Yoga helps me find mental equilibrium after a stressful week.
examples.zh: 瑜伽幫助我在壓力沉重的一週後找回心靈的平衡。

examples.en: Heavy rain can erode the soil on steep hills.
examples.zh: 豪雨會侵蝕陡峭山坡上的土壤。

examples.en: Waves slowly eroded the cliff near our hotel.
examples.zh: 海浪慢慢侵蝕了我們飯店附近的懸崖。

examples.en: Too many mistakes can erode customers' trust in a store.
examples.zh: 太多錯誤會逐漸削弱顧客對商店的信任。

examples.en: Soil erosion is a serious problem on steep farms.
examples.zh: 土壤侵蝕是陡坡農地的一大問題。

examples.en: Planting trees along the river helps prevent erosion.
examples.zh: 沿著河岸種樹有助於防止侵蝕。

examples.en: Years of erosion by the sea have made the beach narrower.
examples.zh: 多年來海水的侵蝕使沙灘變窄了。

examples.en: The library keeps erotic novels on a separate shelf for adults.
examples.zh: 圖書館把情色小說放在另一個專供成人的書架上。

examples.en: The museum explained why some erotic paintings were once banned.
examples.zh: 博物館解釋了為什麼有些情色畫作曾經被禁止展出。

examples.en: Critics say the film's erotic scenes are not suitable for teenagers.
examples.zh: 評論家認為這部電影的情色場面不適合青少年。

examples.en: The report contained an erroneous number that confused everyone.
examples.zh: 報告裡有一個錯誤的數字，讓大家都很困惑。

examples.en: He made an erroneous assumption about the exam date.
examples.zh: 他對考試日期做了錯誤的假設。

examples.en: Please correct any erroneous information on your form.
examples.zh: 請更正表格上任何錯誤的資訊。

senses.zh: 火山爆發；（情緒、聲音等）爆發

examples.en: The eruption of the volcano forced the villagers to leave the island.
examples.zh: 火山爆發迫使村民離開了那座島。

examples.en: Scientists use special tools to predict the next eruption.
examples.zh: 科學家使用特殊儀器來預測下一次火山爆發。

examples.en: An eruption of cheers filled the stadium after the goal.
examples.zh: 進球後，歡呼聲爆發，響徹體育場。

examples.en: The small disagreement began to escalate into a serious problem.
examples.zh: 這個小小的意見不合開始升級成嚴重的問題。

examples.en: Prices of food may escalate if the weather stays dry.
examples.zh: 如果天氣持續乾燥，食物價格可能會節節上漲。

examples.en: The company wants to escalate the matter to a senior manager.
examples.zh: 公司想把這件事上報給高階主管處理。

senses.zh: 有穩固地位的；已確立的

examples.en: The company is well established in the local market.
examples.zh: 這家公司在本地市場已經站穩腳步。

examples.en: She is an established author with ten published novels.
examples.zh: 她是一位已有十本小說出版的知名作家。

examples.en: It is an established rule that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 學生必須穿制服是既定的規定。

examples.en: Our school was established over fifty years ago.
examples.zh: 我們學校創立於五十多年前。

examples.en: The team established a new record at the sports meet.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在運動會上創下新紀錄。

examples.en: He established a small business after he graduated.
examples.zh: 他畢業後創立了一家小公司。

examples.en: The restaurant is a popular establishment near the station.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳是車站附近一間很受歡迎的店。

examples.en: The establishment of the club took only a few weeks.
examples.zh: 這個社團只花了幾週就成立了。

examples.en: Many young people want to challenge the establishment.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人想要挑戰既有體制。

examples.en: The doctor was careful to follow medical ethics.
examples.zh: 這位醫師謹慎地遵守醫學倫理。

examples.en: We studied business ethics in class this week.
examples.zh: 我們這週在課堂上學習了商業倫理。

examples.en: Honesty is an important part of personal ethics.
examples.zh: 誠實是個人道德觀的重要部分。

examples.en: The evacuation of the building took only ten minutes.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓的疏散只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: The school holds an evacuation drill every semester.
examples.zh: 學校每學期都會舉行疏散演練。

examples.en: The typhoon led to the evacuation of several villages.
examples.zh: 颱風使好幾個村莊進行了撤離。

examples.en: Water will evaporate quickly on a hot day.
examples.zh: 在炎熱的日子裡，水很快就會蒸發。

examples.en: The puddle began to evaporate in the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 午後的陽光下，地上的積水開始蒸發。

examples.en: His excitement seemed to evaporate when he saw the bill.
examples.zh: 他看到帳單後，興奮的心情似乎消失了。

examples.en: Evaporation turns liquid water into vapor even at room temperature.
examples.zh: 即使在室溫下，蒸發也會把液態水變成水蒸氣。

examples.en: The lake shrank because of heat and evaporation.
examples.zh: 湖泊因為高溫和蒸發而縮小了。

examples.en: We measured the rate of evaporation in the science lab.
examples.zh: 我們在自然科實驗室測量了蒸發的速率。

examples.en: The test was exceedingly difficult for most students.
examples.zh: 這次考試對大多數學生來說極其困難。

examples.en: She was exceedingly polite to every guest at the party.
examples.zh: 她對派對上的每位客人都非常有禮貌。

examples.en: The mountain road is exceedingly narrow and steep.
examples.zh: 這條山路非常狹窄又陡峭。

senses.zh: 舉例說明；是……的典型代表

examples.en: Her kindness exemplifies the spirit of our school.
examples.zh: 她的善良體現了我們學校的精神。

examples.en: This painting exemplifies the style of the period.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是那個時期風格的典型代表。

examples.en: The teacher used a story to exemplify the idea.
examples.zh: 老師用一個故事來說明這個概念。

examples.en: We plan to improve the existing facilities first.
examples.zh: 我們打算先改善現有的設施。

examples.en: The new software works with existing computers.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體可以搭配現有的電腦使用。

examples.en: Please read the existing rules before you join.
examples.zh: 加入之前請先閱讀現行的規定。

examples.en: The school may expel students who cheat repeatedly.
examples.zh: 學校可能會開除一再作弊的學生。

examples.en: Fans help expel hot air from the room.
examples.zh: 風扇能幫忙把熱空氣排出房間。

examples.en: The club decided to expel the member who broke the rules.
examples.zh: 社團決定將違反規定的成員除名。

examples.en: They expend a lot of energy on this project.
examples.zh: 他們在這個專案上花費了大量精力。

examples.en: We should not expend too much money on decorations.
examples.zh: 我們不該在裝飾上花太多錢。

examples.en: Running a marathon will expend all your strength.
examples.zh: 跑馬拉松會耗盡你所有的體力。

examples.en: We are looking for an experienced teacher.
examples.zh: 我們正在找一位經驗豐富的老師。

examples.en: The experienced guide led us safely up the mountain.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的嚮導帶我們平安登上了山。

examples.en: She is an experienced driver who rarely makes mistakes.
examples.zh: 她是個很少出錯的資深駕駛。

examples.en: We experienced heavy traffic on the way home.
examples.zh: 我們回家途中遇到嚴重塞車。

examples.en: He experienced culture shock during his first week abroad.
examples.zh: 他在國外的第一週經歷了文化衝擊。

examples.en: Many tourists experienced the local food for the first time.
examples.zh: 許多遊客第一次體驗了當地的美食。

examples.en: The science exposition opens next week at the convention center.
examples.zh: 科學博覽會下週在會展中心開幕。

examples.en: Her exposition of the problem was clear and simple.
examples.zh: 她對這個問題的闡述清楚又簡單。

examples.en: The city hosts a travel exposition every spring.
examples.zh: 這座城市每年春天都會舉辦旅遊展。

examples.en: The student faced expulsion after repeated cheating.
examples.zh: 那位學生因一再作弊而面臨被開除。

examples.en: The expulsion of the noisy guests surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的客人被趕出去，讓大家很驚訝。

examples.en: The club voted on the expulsion of one member.
examples.zh: 社團對一名成員的除名進行了投票。

examples.en: She wore an exquisite silk scarf to the dinner.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條精緻的絲巾去參加晚宴。

examples.en: The museum displays exquisite works of ancient art.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了精美的古代藝術品。

examples.en: The chef prepared an exquisite meal for the guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為賓客準備了一頓絕妙的餐點。

examples.en: Do not judge people only by their externals.
examples.zh: 不要只憑外表來評斷別人。

examples.en: The externals of the old house were in good condition.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的外觀狀況良好。

examples.en: He cares more about externals than about real skills.
examples.zh: 他比較在意表面的東西，而不是真正的能力。

examples.en: The firefighters worked hard to extinguish the fire.
examples.zh: 消防員努力撲滅火勢。

examples.en: Please extinguish the candle before you go to bed.
examples.zh: 睡覺前請把蠟燭熄掉。

examples.en: Every driver should know how to use a fire extinguisher to extinguish small flames.
examples.zh: 每位駕駛都應該知道如何用滅火器撲滅小火苗。

examples.en: The country agreed to extradite the suspect to France.
examples.zh: 該國同意將嫌犯引渡到法國。

examples.en: Some countries refuse to extradite their own citizens.
examples.zh: 有些國家拒絕引渡本國公民。

examples.en: The court must decide whether to extradite the businessman.
examples.zh: 法院必須決定是否引渡這位商人。

examples.en: They held an extravagant wedding at a luxury hotel.
examples.zh: 他們在豪華飯店舉辦了一場奢華的婚禮。

examples.en: It is extravagant to buy a new phone every month.
examples.zh: 每個月買一支新手機太浪費了。

examples.en: The company made extravagant promises to its customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司向顧客做出了誇大的承諾。

examples.en: The leader spoke against extremists of every kind.
examples.zh: 這位領袖公開反對各種極端主義者。

examples.en: Most citizens do not support political extremists.
examples.zh: 大多數市民不支持政治上的極端分子。

examples.en: The website tried to stop extremists from spreading false news.
examples.zh: 這個網站試圖阻止極端分子散布假消息。

examples.en: He holds extremist views that most people reject.
examples.zh: 他抱持著大多數人都無法接受的偏激觀點。

examples.en: The group was known for its extremist ideas.
examples.zh: 這個團體以極端的想法聞名。

examples.en: The newspaper published an extremist opinion about the law.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一則對這項法律持極端立場的意見。

examples.en: He tried to fabricate an excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 他試圖編造一個遲到的藉口。

examples.en: It is wrong to fabricate data in a science report.
examples.zh: 在科學報告中捏造數據是不對的。

examples.en: The factory can fabricate steel parts for bridges.
examples.zh: 這家工廠能製造橋梁用的鋼製零件。

examples.en: Cooking is only one facet of her busy life.
examples.zh: 烹飪只是她忙碌生活的其中一個面向。

examples.en: The jeweler cut each facet of the diamond carefully.
examples.zh: 珠寶匠小心地切割鑽石的每個刻面。

examples.en: Teachers must consider every facet of a student's growth.
examples.zh: 老師必須考慮學生成長的各個層面。

examples.en: Colorful rubber bracelets were a fad among students.
examples.zh: 彩色橡膠手環曾在學生之間風靡一時。

examples.en: The diet was just a fad and did not last long.
examples.zh: 那種飲食法只是一時的流行，並沒有持續多久。

examples.en: Is this game a fad or a lasting trend?
examples.zh: 這款遊戲是一時流行還是長久的趨勢？

examples.en: The country suffered a terrible famine after the drought.
examples.zh: 乾旱過後，該國遭遇了嚴重的饑荒。

examples.en: Aid groups sent food to areas hit by famine.
examples.zh: 援助團體把食物送往受饑荒影響的地區。

examples.en: The famine lasted for nearly two years.
examples.zh: 那場饑荒持續了將近兩年。

examples.en: The menu offers both fatty dishes and lighter vegetable options.
examples.zh: 菜單上既有高脂肪餐點，也有較清爽的蔬菜選項。

examples.en: The doctor told him to avoid fatty meat.
examples.zh: 醫生叫他避免吃肥肉。

examples.en: I felt sick after eating such a fatty meal.
examples.zh: 吃了這麼油膩的一餐後，我覺得不舒服。

examples.en: Climbing the mountain in one day was a great feat.
examples.zh: 一天內登上那座山是一項了不起的壯舉。

examples.en: The young pianist performed an amazing feat on stage.
examples.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家在舞台上展現了驚人的絕技。

examples.en: Building the bridge in six months was an engineering feat.
examples.zh: 在六個月內建成這座橋是一項工程上的壯舉。

examples.en: The sports federation organizes the national games.
examples.zh: 這個體育總會負責舉辦全國運動會。

examples.en: Several states joined together to form a federation.
examples.zh: 幾個州聯合起來組成了一個聯邦。

examples.en: She works for the international football federation.
examples.zh: 她在國際足球總會工作。

examples.en: We hung a bird feeder outside the kitchen window.
examples.zh: 我們在廚房窗外掛了一個餵鳥器。

examples.en: This small stream is a feeder of the main river.
examples.zh: 這條小溪是主要河流的支流。

examples.en: A feeder bus carries passengers to the main station.
examples.zh: 接駁公車把乘客載到主要車站。

examples.en: The club builds a sense of fellowship among its members.
examples.zh: 這個社團培養成員之間的情誼。

examples.en: She won a fellowship to study abroad for a year.
examples.zh: 她獲得了一筆出國進修一年的獎學金。

examples.en: Members of the church enjoy fellowship after each service.
examples.zh: 教會成員在每次聚會後都享受彼此交流的時光。

examples.en: Feminism supports equal rights for women and men.
examples.zh: 女性主義支持男女平權。

examples.en: She wrote a school report about the history of feminism.
examples.zh: 她寫了一份關於女性主義歷史的學校報告。

examples.en: Many students joined the talk on feminism and education.
examples.zh: 許多學生參加了關於女性主義與教育的講座。

examples.en: My aunt is a feminist who supports equal pay.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是支持同工同酬的女性主義者。

examples.en: The author is a well-known feminist whose work explores women's history.
examples.zh: 這位作家是知名的女性主義者，作品探討女性歷史。

examples.en: Many feminists work to improve education for girls.
examples.zh: 許多女性主義者致力於改善女孩的教育。

examples.en: She joined a feminist group on campus.
examples.zh: 她加入了校園裡的女性主義社團。

examples.en: The film gives a feminist view of history.
examples.zh: 這部電影從女性主義的角度看待歷史。

examples.en: He read a feminist book for his literature class.
examples.zh: 他為了文學課讀了一本女性主義的書。

examples.en: He plays the fiddle at the village festival.
examples.zh: 他在村裡的慶典上拉小提琴。

examples.en: The old man learned to play the fiddle as a boy.
examples.zh: 那位老先生小時候就學會了拉小提琴。

examples.en: A lively fiddle tune filled the room.
examples.zh: 輕快的小提琴曲調充滿了整個房間。

examples.en: Stop trying to fiddle with the radio while driving.
examples.zh: 開車時別再擺弄收音機了。

examples.en: She likes to fiddle with her pen during class.
examples.zh: 她上課時喜歡一直玩弄手上的筆。

examples.en: Don't fiddle with the settings on my computer.
examples.zh: 不要亂動我電腦的設定。

examples.en: His fidelity to his friends was never in doubt.
examples.zh: 他對朋友的忠誠從來沒有人懷疑過。

examples.en: The translation was praised for its fidelity to the original.
examples.zh: 這篇翻譯因忠實呈現原文而受到稱讚。

examples.en: This speaker system offers high fidelity sound.
examples.zh: 這套喇叭系統提供高傳真的音質。

examples.en: The main finding of the study surprised the scientists.
examples.zh: 這項研究的主要發現讓科學家們很驚訝。

examples.en: The report shared its findings with the public.
examples.zh: 這份報告向大眾公布了調查結果。

examples.en: The finding of the old coin made the news.
examples.zh: 那枚古幣的發現登上了新聞。

examples.en: The firefighter climbed the ladder to save the cat.
examples.zh: 消防員爬上梯子去救那隻貓。

examples.en: My uncle works as a firefighter in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在台北當消防員。

examples.en: Every firefighter must train hard to stay strong.
examples.zh: 每位消防員都必須努力訓練以保持體力。

examples.en: We booked first-class seats for the long flight.
examples.zh: 我們為這趟長途飛行訂了頭等艙座位。

examples.en: The hotel provides first-class service to all guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為所有房客提供一流的服務。

examples.en: She received a first-class education at that school.
examples.zh: 她在那所學校接受了一流的教育。

examples.en: They traveled first-class to Japan last summer.
examples.zh: 他們去年夏天搭頭等艙去日本。

examples.en: He always flies first-class on business trips.
examples.zh: 他出差時總是搭乘頭等艙。

examples.en: We could not afford to travel first-class.
examples.zh: 我們負擔不起搭頭等艙旅行。

examples.en: A quiet song was a fitting end to the evening.
examples.zh: 一首安靜的歌是這個夜晚恰當的結尾。

examples.en: It is fitting that she won the award.
examples.zh: 她得獎是理所當然的。

examples.en: He gave a fitting answer to the difficult question.
examples.zh: 他對這個難題給出了恰當的答覆。

examples.en: I have a fitting for my new suit tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要試穿新西裝。

examples.en: The plumber replaced a broken fitting under the sink.
examples.zh: 水電工換掉了水槽下方壞掉的接頭。

examples.en: The dress needs one more fitting before the wedding.
examples.zh: 這件禮服在婚禮前還需要再試穿一次。

examples.en: The price of the ticket is fixed.
examples.zh: 這張票的價格是固定的。

examples.en: We meet at a fixed time every week.
examples.zh: 我們每週在固定的時間見面。

examples.en: The desk is fixed to the wall so it cannot move.
examples.zh: 這張桌子固定在牆上，所以不會移動。

examples.en: My father fixed the broken bike yesterday.
examples.zh: 我爸爸昨天把壞掉的腳踏車修好了。

examples.en: She fixed the shelf to the wall with four screws.
examples.zh: 她用四根螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

examples.en: The teacher fixed the date of the exam.
examples.zh: 老師訂好了考試的日期。

senses.zh: 固定裝置；固定陳設；常客

examples.en: The bathroom has a new lighting fixture.
examples.zh: 浴室裝了新的燈具。

examples.en: The old clock is a fixture in our living room.
examples.zh: 那座舊時鐘一直都擺在我們的客廳裡。

examples.en: He has become a fixture at the local coffee shop.
examples.zh: 他已經成了當地咖啡店的常客。

examples.en: Trees stood on each flank of the road.
examples.zh: 道路兩側都有樹木。

examples.en: The farmer patted the horse on its flank.
examples.zh: 農夫輕拍馬的腹側。

examples.en: Soldiers protected the left flank of the camp.
examples.zh: 士兵守護著營地的左翼。

examples.en: Tall trees flank the path to the school.
examples.zh: 高大的樹木排列在通往學校的小徑兩側。

examples.en: Two guards flank the door of the museum.
examples.zh: 兩名警衛站在博物館門的兩側。

examples.en: The singer was flanked by her two friends.
examples.zh: 歌手的兩側各站著一位朋友。

examples.en: The bird began to flap its wings.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥開始拍動翅膀。

examples.en: The flag flaps in the strong wind.
examples.zh: 旗子在強風中飄動。

examples.en: Don't flap the paper in front of my face.
examples.zh: 不要在我面前揮動那張紙。

examples.en: Close the flap on the envelope firmly.
examples.zh: 把信封的封口片牢牢合上。

examples.en: The tent has a flap that works as a door.
examples.zh: 這頂帳篷有一片可當作門的垂簾。

examples.en: We heard the flap of wings above us.
examples.zh: 我們聽到頭上傳來拍翅聲。

senses.zh: 閃光；信號彈；突然燃起的火光

examples.en: The sailors fired a flare to ask for help.
examples.zh: 水手們發射信號彈求救。

examples.en: A bright flare lit up the dark road.
examples.zh: 一道明亮的閃光照亮了漆黑的道路。

examples.en: Every boat must carry a flare for emergencies.
examples.zh: 每艘船都必須攜帶信號彈以備緊急情況。

examples.en: The match flared and then went out.
examples.zh: 火柴突然亮了一下就熄滅了。

examples.en: Tempers began to flare during the long meeting.
examples.zh: 冗長的會議中，大家開始動怒。

examples.en: The campfire flared when he added more wood.
examples.zh: 他添了更多木柴後，營火猛然竄高。

examples.en: She flicked the dust off her sleeve.
examples.zh: 她輕輕拍掉袖子上的灰塵。

examples.en: He flicked the switch and the room lit up.
examples.zh: 他按了一下開關，房間就亮了。

examples.en: The cat flicked its tail and walked away.
examples.zh: 那隻貓甩了甩尾巴就走開了。

senses.zh: 輕甩；快速翻動；電影（口語）

examples.en: With a flick of her wrist, she threw the ball.
examples.zh: 她手腕一甩就把球丟了出去。

examples.en: A quick flick of the page showed the answer.
examples.zh: 快速翻一下頁面就看到了答案。

examples.en: We watched a funny flick at the neighborhood cinema last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在附近的電影院看了一部好笑的電影。

examples.en: The candle began to flicker in the wind.
examples.zh: 蠟燭在風中開始搖曳。

examples.en: The lights flicker whenever it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 每當下大雨時，燈光就會閃爍。

examples.en: A smile flickered across her face when she recognized her old friend.
examples.zh: 她認出老朋友時，臉上閃過一抹微笑。

examples.en: We saw a flicker of light in the window.
examples.zh: 我們看見窗戶裡有一點閃爍的光。

examples.en: There was a flicker of hope in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼中閃現一絲希望。

examples.en: The flicker of the old lamp hurt my eyes.
examples.zh: 那盞舊燈的閃爍讓我的眼睛很不舒服。

examples.en: He flung his bag onto the sofa and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把背包往沙發上一丟，就坐了下來。

examples.en: She flung open the window to let in fresh air.
examples.zh: 她猛地推開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。

examples.en: The child flung his arms around his mother.
examples.zh: 那個孩子張開雙臂緊緊抱住媽媽。

senses.zh: 重重倒下；砰地坐下；失敗

examples.en: He flopped onto the bed after a long day.
examples.zh: 忙了一整天後，他整個人癱倒在床上。

examples.en: The new product flopped in the market.
examples.zh: 這項新產品在市場上慘敗。

examples.en: The tired child flopped into the chair.
examples.zh: 疲倦的孩子重重坐進椅子裡。

examples.en: The movie was a complete flop at the box office.
examples.zh: 這部電影在票房上徹底慘敗。

examples.en: The school play turned out to be a flop.
examples.zh: 學校的戲劇演出結果大失敗。

examples.en: After the flop, the company changed its plan.
examples.zh: 慘敗之後，公司改變了計畫。

senses.zh: 掙扎；不知所措；笨拙地行動

examples.en: The swimmer began to flounder in the deep water.
examples.zh: 那位游泳者在深水中開始掙扎。

examples.en: The new student floundered during his first speech.
examples.zh: 這位新生在第一次演講時不知所措。

examples.en: The business may flounder without more support.
examples.zh: 若沒有更多支持，這家公司可能會陷入困境。

examples.en: We ordered grilled flounder for dinner at a seaside restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊一家餐廳點了烤比目魚當晚餐。

examples.en: The flounder lies flat on the sandy sea floor.
examples.zh: 比目魚平貼在多沙的海底。

examples.en: The fisherman caught a large flounder this morning.
examples.zh: 漁夫今天早上捕到了一條大比目魚。

examples.en: Prices of fresh fruit fluctuate depending on the season and weather.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果的價格會隨季節和天氣而波動。

examples.en: The temperature can fluctuate a lot in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天的氣溫可能起伏很大。

examples.en: Her mood tends to fluctuate during exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週期間，她的情緒常常起伏不定。

examples.en: A butterfly fluttered around the garden before landing on a flower.
examples.zh: 一隻蝴蝶在花園裡翩翩飛舞，然後停在一朵花上。

examples.en: The curtains fluttered in the gentle breeze.
examples.zh: 窗簾在微風中輕輕飄動。

examples.en: Her heart fluttered when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她聽到這個消息時，心怦怦直跳。

examples.en: We heard the flutter of wings above the trees.
examples.zh: 我們聽見樹梢上方傳來拍翅聲。

examples.en: There was a flutter of excitement in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡一陣興奮的騷動。

examples.en: The gentle flutter of the curtains showed that the window was open.
examples.zh: 窗簾輕輕飄動，顯示窗戶開著。

examples.en: Wrap the fish in foil before baking it.
examples.zh: 烘烤前先用鋁箔紙把魚包起來。

examples.en: Her bright dress was a perfect foil to his plain suit.
examples.zh: 她鮮豔的洋裝完美襯托出他樸素的西裝。

examples.en: He used foil to cover the leftover food.
examples.zh: 他用鋁箔紙蓋住剩下的食物。

examples.en: The guard foiled the attempt to steal the painting.
examples.zh: 警衛挫敗了偷畫的企圖。

examples.en: Heavy rain foiled our plan to go camping.
examples.zh: 大雨破壞了我們去露營的計畫。

examples.en: Police foiled the plot before anyone was hurt.
examples.zh: 警方在有人受傷之前就阻止了這項陰謀。

senses.zh: 後續行動；追蹤報導；回診

examples.en: The manager sent a follow-up after the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會後發送了後續訊息。

examples.en: I have a follow-up with my dentist next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我下週二要回診看牙醫。

examples.en: The magazine published a follow-up to last month's story.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌刊出了上個月那篇報導的後續。

examples.en: Please answer the follow-up questions on the next page.
examples.zh: 請回答下一頁的後續問題。

examples.en: She made a follow-up call to confirm the order.
examples.zh: 她又打了一通電話來確認訂單。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a follow-up visit in two weeks.
examples.zh: 醫師建議兩週後再回診一次。

examples.en: The news program showed footage of the parade.
examples.zh: 新聞節目播出了遊行的影像畫面。

examples.en: We watched old footage of our school sports day.
examples.zh: 我們看了學校運動會的舊影片。

examples.en: The museum has rare footage from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一九六〇年代的珍貴影像。

examples.en: I heard a footstep behind me in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我聽到走廊上我身後有腳步聲。

examples.en: Her footstep was light as she crossed the room.
examples.zh: 她走過房間時腳步很輕。

examples.en: We followed his footsteps up the muddy trail.
examples.zh: 我們沿著他的足跡走上泥濘的小徑。

examples.en: Parking is forbidden in front of the school gate.
examples.zh: 學校大門前禁止停車。

examples.en: Eating in the library is strictly forbidden.
examples.zh: 圖書館內嚴禁進食。

examples.en: The children were curious about the forbidden room upstairs.
examples.zh: 孩子們對樓上那間禁止進入的房間很好奇。

examples.en: She is the foremost expert on bird migration in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 她是台灣研究鳥類遷徙的頭號專家。

examples.en: Safety is our foremost concern on school trips.
examples.zh: 安全是我們校外教學時最重要的考量。

examples.en: He is one of the foremost writers of his time.
examples.zh: 他是那個時代最傑出的作家之一。

examples.en: First and foremost, thank you all for coming.
examples.zh: 首先，感謝大家的蒞臨。

examples.en: Please remember, first and foremost, to bring your ID card.
examples.zh: 請務必先記得帶身分證。

examples.en: The company is, first and foremost, a family business.
examples.zh: 這家公司說到底是一家家族企業。

examples.en: We will be on vacation for a fortnight in July.
examples.zh: 我們七月會去度假兩週。

examples.en: The report is due in a fortnight.
examples.zh: 報告兩週後到期。

examples.en: It rained almost every day for a fortnight.
examples.zh: 連續兩週幾乎天天下雨。

examples.en: My grandmother is old and rather frail now.
examples.zh: 我奶奶年紀大了，現在身體相當虛弱。

examples.en: The frail bridge could not hold heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座脆弱的橋承受不了重型卡車。

examples.en: He felt frail after a week in bed with the flu.
examples.zh: 他因流感臥床一週後，覺得身體很虛弱。

senses.zh: 法郎（瑞士等國的貨幣單位）

examples.en: The souvenir cost ten francs in Geneva.
examples.zh: 這個紀念品在日內瓦要十法郎。

examples.en: The franc was the currency of France before the euro.
examples.zh: 法國在採用歐元之前使用法郎。

examples.en: Swiss francs are accepted at most shops here.
examples.zh: 這裡大多數商店都收瑞士法郎。

examples.en: Don't fret about the test; you studied hard.
examples.zh: 別為考試煩惱，你已經很用功了。

examples.en: She fretted over every small detail of the party.
examples.zh: 她對派對的每個小細節都很操心。

examples.en: Parents often fret when their children travel alone.
examples.zh: 孩子獨自旅行時，父母常常會擔心。

senses.zh: 琴衍（指板上的金屬橫條）；焦慮

examples.en: He was in a fret about the missing keys.
examples.zh: 他為了不見的鑰匙焦躁不安。

examples.en: Press the string just behind the second fret.
examples.zh: 把琴弦按在緊靠第二條琴衍後方的位置。

examples.en: The fret on this old guitar needs repair.
examples.zh: 這把舊吉他的那條琴衍需要修理。

examples.en: The village lies on the fringe of the forest.
examples.zh: 這個村莊位於森林的邊緣。

examples.en: The scarf has a long fringe at both ends.
examples.zh: 這條圍巾兩端都有長長的流蘇。

examples.en: She cut her fringe before the school photo.
examples.zh: 她在拍學校照片前剪了劉海。

examples.en: The fringe group has very few members.
examples.zh: 這個非主流團體的成員非常少。

examples.en: He enjoys fringe theater more than big musicals.
examples.zh: 比起大型音樂劇，他更喜歡非主流劇場。

examples.en: The company offers fringe benefits such as free meals and gym access.
examples.zh: 公司提供免費餐點及健身房使用權等額外福利。

examples.en: The accident was front-page news this morning.
examples.zh: 這起意外是今天早上的頭版新聞。

examples.en: Her photo appeared in a front-page story.
examples.zh: 她的照片出現在一篇頭版報導中。

examples.en: The mayor's speech made a front-page headline.
examples.zh: 市長的演說登上了頭版標題。

examples.en: We had a fruitful discussion about the project.
examples.zh: 我們就這個專案進行了一場很有成果的討論。

examples.en: Her fruitful career lasted more than thirty years.
examples.zh: 她成果豐碩的事業持續了三十多年。

examples.en: The farmer hopes for a fruitful harvest this autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫希望今年秋天能有豐收。

examples.en: The fumes from the traffic made me cough.
examples.zh: 車流的廢氣讓我咳嗽。

examples.en: Open the window to let the paint fumes out.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶，讓油漆揮發的氣體散出去。

examples.en: Workers must wear masks to avoid breathing in the fumes.
examples.zh: 工人必須戴口罩，以免吸入煙霧。

examples.en: The professor wrote a book about religious fundamentalism.
examples.zh: 那位教授寫了一本關於宗教基本教義派的書。

examples.en: Fundamentalism can appear in many different religions.
examples.zh: 基本教義主義可能出現在許多不同的宗教中。

examples.en: Students discussed the rise of fundamentalism in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上討論了原教旨主義的興起。

examples.en: The article describes a fundamentalist who rejects modern ideas.
examples.zh: 這篇文章描述了一位排斥現代觀念的基本教義派人士。

examples.en: A fundamentalist usually follows religious texts very strictly.
examples.zh: 基本教義派信徒通常嚴格遵守宗教經典。

examples.en: The writer interviewed a former fundamentalist about his life.
examples.zh: 作者訪問了一位前基本教義派人士，談他的人生。

examples.en: The town has a fundamentalist church on the hill.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的山丘上有一間基本教義派的教會。
